final.summary_ko:
사용자가 말한 6개(스킬창·가방·장비창·전투력·랭킹·키 설정)와, 빠져 있던 기본 기능을 베타 계약 하나로 묶은 최종본이다. 비평 3건의 높음·중간 지적을 모두 반영했다.

바뀐 점:
- BB17(자리 비움 자동 쉼)을 뺐다. A23-20 '계속 사냥'(SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:91-96, Config.luau:394 AutoIdleRest=false)과 부딪힌다. 대신 Roblox 20분 무입력 퇴장 예고(BB39)를 넣었다.
- BB27(원한 골드 우편)을 뺐다. 커밋 735419e에서 GrudgeService MAIL로 이미 들어갔다.
- 키 설정:
  - G 키가 겹치던 문제를 풀었다. 커밋된 GrudgeGhost.luau:79가 G를 고정으로 쓰고 있었다. 이제 가방은 G, 유령 붙잡기는 T이고, 모든 키를 Keybinds 한곳에서 다룬다.
  - 키 비우기, F1~F8·숫자패드·기호·Ctrl·Alt를 쓸 수 있다.
  - 창 키를 다시 누르면 그 창이 닫힌다.
  - 새 기본 키가 내 키와 겹쳐도 내 키는 지워지지 않는다.
  - 서버의 1초 제한 때문에 마지막 변경이 되돌아가지 않도록 Seq 번호를 붙인다.
- 전투력 상한: 8티어(젤리 전설, 공격력 76, Config.luau:186)는 가장 센 무기가 아니다. 그래서 상한을 Config.MaxCombatPower()=25,488로 바꿨다. 공식으로 직접 계산해 확인했다.
- 랭킹:
  - 주간 명예·악명 점수는 공정한 PvP에서만 준다. 친구, 자리 비움, 약한 상대, 같은 상대 반복은 빠진다. 털기 자루 점수도 KO 순간에 판정한다.
  - 장인 길드도 들어갈 수 있는 주간 '사냥' 판을 추가했다.
  - 최고값은 시즌마다 따로 센다. 디버그·테스트 저장은 빠지고, Studio 시험용 우회가 있고, 사설 서버는 세지 않는다.
  - 시즌 이름은 베타 전에는 PRE, 베타 날 B1이다.
- 이름 숨기기: 서버 전체 알림 모두에 적용한다(BB37 PublicName).
- 창 구조:
  - Panels.Register에 인자 전달, 정리 훅, 일부만 다시 그리기를 넣었다.
  - Items는 파일을 나누는 대신 기존 표를 내보내기만 한다.
  - 장비창의 3D 몸 미리보기는 권장(BB8b)으로 옮겼다.
- 가방에 골라 팔기를 넣었다. '모두 팔기'는 일반 재료만 판다.
- 새로 넣은 기본 기능: 베타 지표(P6, BB38), 의견 보내기, 데이터 삭제 절차, '베타에 안 넣는 기본 기능과 이유' 목록.

일정: 필수만 명목 약 16일이다. 펫·Z·핼러윈과 합치면 남은 19일에 다 들어가지 않는다. 그래서 지금 순서와 빼는 순서를 정하고, 점검일을 10/12·10/17·10/20으로 앞당겼다. 사용자에게는 일정·범위·PvP 공정성·보상 다섯 가지만 묻는다.

features.contract:
Config:
- Config.Power = { DisplayScale=10, Text = { Label='전투력', LabelEn='Power', Formula='레벨과 무기(강화 포함)로 정해져요', PvPNote='무기 공격력 차이가 커도 PvP 피해는 최대 1.5배, 최소 0.8배예요', Up='전투력 +%s' } }, with En keys alongside.
- Config.Bully.Text = { Title='깡패가 되는 경우', Lines built with string.format from WeakPowerRatio, FreshSpawnSeconds and RepeatKOs/RepeatWindow: '내 전투력 절반보다 약한 상대를 쓰러뜨릴 때', '막 부활한 상대(15초 안)를 쓰러뜨릴 때', '같은 상대를 10분 안에 3번 쓰러뜨릴 때' }. BB8, BB15, BB24 and BB28 share it.
- Config.CombatPower(level, tier, enhance) = math.floor(Config.PowerOf(level, tier, 1, enhance) * DisplayScale + 0.5). It leaves out class, faction, rebirth, Size Justice, bully, buffs and pets.
- Config.MaxCombatPower() = max over t = 1..MaxWeaponTier of CombatPower(Levels.MaxLevel, t, Loot.MaxEnhance), cached (25,488 today).
- Rule: anything that means 'strongest weapon' sorts by Config.Weapons[t].Damage, never by tier index.

JusticeService:
- GetCombatPower returns this integer. The bully test and BoldMult compare it; their ratios do not change.
- GetPower stays as it is ('진영 힘').
- onPlayerReady connects GetAttributeChangedSignal for Level, WeaponTier and WeaponEnhance to one task.defer-coalesced refresh, because LootService writes WeaponEnhance after WeaponTier.
- The refresh calls player:SetAttribute('CombatPower', n). Disconnect on leave.

Live rule: an action is live when its Flag is on and, for the Window group, its Panels id is registered. Non-live actions hold no key and take no part in swaps.

Key sets:
- Reserved = {Escape, Slash, Tab, Backquote, Return, KeypadEnter, Space, LeftShift, RightShift, W, A, S, D, I, O, Comma, Period, PageUp, PageDown, Up, Down, Left, Right, F9, F10, F11, F12}. The Roblox camera uses I/O, Comma/Period, the arrows and PageUp/PageDown.
- Allowed = A–Z, Zero–Nine, F1–F8, Keypad0–Keypad9, Minus, Equals, LeftBracket, RightBracket, Semicolon, Quote, BackSlash, LeftControl, LeftAlt, CapsLock, minus Reserved.

Shared pure functions:
- Config.KeyMap(sparse, liveSet) → full action→key map, with the collision rule from BB2.

Keybinds.luau:
- New client ModuleScript. In ClientMain ORDER it goes right after 'UIKit', before Fx, VitalsUI, HUD and GrudgeGhost.
- API: Get, ActionFor, Label (returns a button name on touch-only devices), PadFor, Changed (Util.Signal), Apply(sparse), SetLocal(action, key) (swap with the live holder, which gets my old key or ''), Clear(action), Reset, IsCapturing, Capture(action, cb) (BB3), Collisions(), and Dispatch(fakeInput) (test hook used through execute_luau).

- HUD onInputBegan/onInputEnded dispatch through ActionFor. Keep the gameProcessed and TextBox guards.
- Window-group actions and Menu are handled before inputAllowed(): if Panels.CurrentId() == target, call Panels.Close(true); otherwise call Panels.Open(target), which switches windows.

- Interact: ProximityPromptService.PromptShown sets prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Get('Interact'), re-applied on Changed. If Studio shows prompts ignore this, show the row as '고정 E' and add E to Reserved at runtime.

Unchanged: short left-click attack, left-drag camera, Intro Return/KeypadEnter/ButtonA, WorldMap ButtonB/Escape close.

Text tokens:

features.contract:
Data (additive, Version stays 3; not in Mirrored):
- Config.Data.Defaults.Settings = { V=1, Keys={}, Sfx=1, Shake=true, DmgNum='All', Tags='All', KeyBadges=true, Lang='Auto', BagSort='Default' }.

Config.Settings.Defs:
- Sfx: Number 0..1, Step 0.1
- Shake: Bool
- DmgNum: Enum All / Off
- Tags: Enum All / Near / Off
- KeyBadges: Bool
- Lang: Enum Auto / ko / en
- BagSort: Enum Default / Grade / Count
- Text table (KO + EN).

Config.SanitizeSettings(t) (pure, shared by server and client):
- Drops unknown keys.
- Keys is a sparse map: action id → '' or a key name of 24 chars or fewer, in Allowed and not in Reserved. Entries equal to the default are dropped.
- Numbers must be finite; they are clamped and snapped to Step. Bools must be boolean. Enums must be in Options. Anything else falls back to the default.
- DataService.fillDefaults sets d.Settings = Config.SanitizeSettings(d.Settings).

Collision rule (Config.KeyMap). Never wipe all keys:
1. Explicit entries are applied first, in Actions order. An explicit entry whose key is already taken becomes ''.
2. A live default-only action whose default key is taken becomes '' and is reported through Keybinds.Collisions(). The client toasts once per action per session: '새 동작 [%s]의 기본 키 %s가 이미 쓰여서 비워 뒀어요. 설정에서 정해 주세요'.

SettingsService.luau:
- New server module. Main.server.luau: INIT after 'AnnounceService', START before 'PlayerService'.

Remotes:
- c→s 'SetSettings'(blob?). select('#') <= 1. Zero args means 'send me mine'.
  - When present, blob is a table with at most 16 top-level keys and blob.Seq is an integer the server clamps to 0..2^31.
  - Checks: PlayerService.IsReady and Util.RateLimit(player, 'SetSettings', Config.RateLimits.SetSettings = 1).
  - On a rate-limit drop, send nothing.
  - Otherwise save Config.SanitizeSettings(blob) into GetData(player).Settings and echo.
- s→c 'Settings' { Seq, Settings }, owner only. Also sent once on PlayerReady.

Client:
- Pull once at Start.
- Keep one pending blob and send it at max(now, lastSent + RateLimits.SetSettings + 0.05). On window close, flush through the same slot and never send twice inside the limit.
- Ignore echoes with Seq lower than the newest Seq sent.
- Otherwise the server value wins.

features.contract:
Panels.Register(id, opts):
- opts = { Build = fn(parent, kit, arg) -> update?, Title, FixedBody = bool, Rebuild = { [attr] = true } | false, Cleanup = fn() }.
- It adds the window to BUILDERS and T.Titles.
- Panels.Open stores the arg (RENDER.Arg). render() passes it to Build and calls the previous window's Cleanup before clearContent. Panels.Close calls Cleanup.
- For registered windows, REBUILD_ATTRS applies only to attributes listed in opts.Rebuild. Windows refresh themselves through kit.OnAttr.
- With FixedBody, the body is a plain Frame instead of the ScrollingFrame + UIListLayout, so tabs stay pinned.
- kit = { Button, Toast, Fire, Palette, NextOrder, Rebuild, Close, Open, OnAttr }.

New exports: Panels.CurrentId() and Panels.IsRegistered(id).

Close rules:
- GuiService.MenuOpened (Esc) closes the open Panels window, the same as WorldMap.
- ButtonB closes every Panels window (pad).

New UI modules go after 'Panels' in ClientMain ORDER and call Register in Init. Tab state lives in the module, not in the builder closure.

Menu:
- BUILDERS.Menu uses Config.Menu.Sections, an ordered list of { Title, TitleEn, Ids }.
- Each section is a header plus a 2-column grid of 60+ px buttons. An entry shows only when its window is registered.
- '오프닝 다시 보기' and '이름 숨기기' move to Settings (BB3).

features.contract:
Window:

- Tabs: [키 설정][기타]. The arg {Tab='Keys'} opens the key tab.

Key list:
- Only live actions (BB1). Each row has a key button and [비우기] (Keybinds.Clear).
- Unbound rows show '없음' highlighted.

Keybinds.Capture:
- ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority('HH_KeyCapture', fn, false, 4000, Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard), returning Sink for every key. 4000 is above WorldMap and Intro.
- IsCapturing() is a second guard.
- Ends after 5 s, on [취소], on GuiService.MenuOpened (Esc belongs to Roblox) and in the window Cleanup. Always UnbindAction.
- Rules: a Reserved key → toast Settings.Text.Reserved. A key outside Allowed → reject. A key another live action holds → swap and toast. No modifier combos.
- Changes apply at once on the client and persist through BB2.
- [기본값으로] asks once to confirm, then sets Keys = {}.

Other rows apply locally; read settings lazily through the registry:
- Sfx: a multiplier inside an existing Fx table, applied to SOUND_VOLUME.
- Shake: Fx.Shake runs only when Settings.Shake is on and GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled is off.
- KeyBadges: drives HUD L.ShowKeys.
- Name hiding: fires the existing SetAnnounceName. The note text comes from BB37.
- '오프닝 다시 보기': keeps its existing town-only rule.

No camera sensitivity row. CameraFollow multiplies RADIANS_PER_PIXEL by UserSettings():GetService('UserGameSettings').MouseSensitivity, read when used, so Roblox's own sensitivity setting controls both drags.

Footer:
- Config.BuildLabel, game.PlaceVersion, JobId:sub(1,8) and players n/Max.
- '저장 꺼짐' when GameState SaveOK == false. The server sets SaveOK = not DataService.IsMemoryMode(); add SaveOK to Net.GameStateDefaults.

Text: Config.Settings.Text; Keybinds Label / LabelEn.

The damage-number and nametag rows are BB3b.

- 탭: [장비][소모품][주문서][재료]. 탭마다 새 아이템 수가 붙는다.
- 칸마다 그림, 개수(×N), 강화(+N), '장착' 표시, 새 아이템 점이 있다.
- 칸을 누르면 설명이 나온다: 등급과 별, 어디서 얻는지, 공격력, 슬라임 몇 방인지, 전투력 변화.
- 버튼: [장착][강화][옮기기][사용][팔기(개수 고르기)][일반 재료 모두 팔기].
- 물약은 가방에서 바로 마신다.
- 귀한 재료(왕 슬라임 핵 등)는 '모두 팔기'에 들어가지 않는다. 정식의 제작 재료라서다.
- [재료] 탭 아래에 '몬스터가 주는 것' 표가 이어진다.
- 칸 수 제한은 없다.
features.current_state:
메뉴 → 아이템은 글자 목록뿐이다. 탭도, 그림도, 물약도 없다.

물약:
- HUD 버튼으로만 쓴다(VitalsUI).
- Panels 창이 열려 있으면 물약을 못 쓴다.

팔기:
- 판매는 SellMaterials 하나다(LootService). 등급 구분 없이 재료를 전부 판다.
- A23-18에 따라 베타 저장이 정식까지 이어진다. 그래서 지금 팔린 재료는 정식 제작 때 없다.

HUD와 문구:
- 오른쪽 칸은 자동·지도·메뉴뿐이다. 다음 무기 카드가 그 줄의 너비(rowW)에 맞춰 놓인다.
- '메뉴 → 아이템' 문구가 Config와 Fx에 있다.
- visual_direction_2026-10-05.md:809에 기록이 있다: 749×361에서 EventHUD 오늘의 운 판(210×58)이 오른쪽 칸 줄과 부딪힌다.
features.contract:
Window:
- Panels id 'Bag', registered with FixedBody and Rebuild = false. UI in the new client module BagUI.luau (ORDER after Panels).
- Layout from top: gold line (금고 + 주머니), tabs with NEW badges, sort pill (Settings.BagSort), then a ScrollingFrame with UIGridLayout of 88 px cells.
- Cell: grade frame drawn as a code fallback (dark fill + 3 px UIStroke in the WeaponGrade colour + stars). Icon through UIKit.ArtImage. ×N, +N, 장착 chip, NEW dot.
- The 재료 tab ends with the P7 '몬스터가 주는 것' text (Config.ItemSources + Data.Seen).
- Detail pane: on a canvas 640 px or wider, grid 60% | detail 40%. At 749×361 the detail replaces the grid and shows a [← 가방] button.
- Tap targets are 60 canvas px or more.

Actions:
- EquipWeapon(tier).
- UseItem(itemId, tier[, toTier]), through the existing mode → pick → confirm flow and the ITEMS guard.
- Potions fire UsePotion(kind) after the same checks through an exported VitalsUI.PotionState(kind) (full / kaiju / dead / cooldown).
- During PvP combat the buttons show '전투 중'.

New remote c→s 'SellItem'(itemId, n):
- itemId: a string of 32 chars or fewer that is a Material in Config.Loot.Items. n: an integer from 1 to the held count.
- select('#') == 2, IsReady, not PvP combat-tagged, the same anvil check as SellMaterials, RateLimits.SellItem = 0.3.
- Remove before pay. Price = Items[id].Sell × n.

SellMaterials changes on the server: it skips materials whose Grade ~= 'Common'. The client asks once to confirm ('젤리 12, 이빨 5 → 84골드').

Sell buttons are enabled only near the anvil. Elsewhere they show '대장간 모루에서 팔아요'.

HUD:
- Add a 4th BtnSquare 'Bag' (IconPouch).
- Keep a separate L.UpgradeRowW = 3*SQ + 2*RG for the next-weapon card. Use the 4-wide value only for ClusterLeft, and check that ClusterLeft stays right of 60% of the width at 749×361.
- Move the B14 scroll glow from 메뉴 to 가방. The first-scroll toast opens Bag on the 주문서 tab.
- Menu entry 아이템 → 가방. The '메뉴 → 아이템' strings become '가방'.
- The step-6 grey-box rail replaces this square, so spend no art or polish on it.

Text: Config.Bag.Text (KO + EN).
features.keys_and_mobile: PC: G키 또는 오른쪽 위 [가방]. 칸은 클릭으로 고르고, 끌어 옮기기는 쓰지 않는다. 폰: [가방] 버튼(누르는 범위 60 이상). 상세는 화면을 바꿔 열린다. 패드: 메뉴 → 가방으로 열고, Roblox UI 선택으로 칸을 옮기며, B로 닫는다.
acceptance_ko: 슬라임에게서 젤리를 얻으면 [재료] 탭에 새 아이템 점과 개수가 생긴다. 그 탭을 보면 점이 사라진다.
가방에서 HP 물약 [사용]을 누르면 HP가 차고 개수가 1 줄어든다. HP가 가득이면 버튼이 '가득'으로 꺼진다.
주문서 [사용] → 무기 고르기 → 확인을 하면 결과 문구와 '전투력 A → B'가 뜬다. +N이 가방·장비창·대장간에 똑같이 보인다.
모루 근처에서 젤리 3개를 [팔기]하면 정확히 3개만 팔린다. [일반 재료 모두 팔기]를 해도 왕 슬라임 핵은 가방에 남는다.
749×361과 1280×720에서 HUD 오른쪽 줄, 오늘의 운 판, 퀘스트 판의 사각형이 겹치지 않는다(execute_luau로 AbsolutePosition·AbsoluteSize를 잼). 겹치면 운 판을 전쟁 바 아래 줄로 옮긴다.
749×361에서는 88 칸, 상세 화면 전환, [← 가방] 버튼이 보이고 글자가 안 잘린다.
PvP 전투 중에는 장착·주문서·팔기 버튼이 '전투 중'으로 바뀐다.

features.current_state:
스킬 정의는 Config.BasicSkill 하나뿐이다. 세 직업이 같은 수치를 쓰고, 스킬 이름도 없다.

features.contract:

features.name_ko: 랭킹 서비스 (이 서버·전체, 시즌·주간, 공정 점수)
features.player_view_ko:
랭킹 판은 다섯이다.
- 이번 시즌 최고 전투력
- 성장(환생·레벨)
- 이번 주 사냥(모든 진영)
- 이번 주 명예(빛의 기사단)
- 이번 주 악명(뿔 군단)

갱신과 참가:
- 전체 랭킹은 2~3분마다 새로 고쳐진다.
- 주간 판은 월요일 0시(한국 시간)에 새로 시작한다.
- 새 계정(3일 미만)이나 플레이 30분 미만은 전체 랭킹에 오르지 않지만, 이 서버 랭킹에는 보인다.

주간 명예·악명 점수는 공정한 싸움에서만 쌓인다. 명예·악명 자체와 골드는 지금과 같다.
- 비슷하거나 센 상대만 센다.
- 친구가 아닌 상대만 센다.
- 방금까지 직접 움직이던 상대만 센다.
- 같은 상대는 한 주에 3번까지 센다.

사냥 판은 자동 전투를 켜 놓고 자리를 비운 동안 잡은 것은 세지 않는다.
features.current_state:

명예·악명이 쌓이는 곳은 7곳이다.
- PvPService.HandleKO: 3곳(:613, :633, :649)
- payLeaveBounty: :856
- GrudgeService pay: :207. 자루의 sack.Infamy는 피해자 정보 없이 합쳐진 값이다(:324).
- StoryQuestService: :480, :519

반복해서 얻는 점수는 PvP KO에서만 나온다. 이야기 퀘스트 점수는 한 번뿐이다.

- Studio 테스트 클라이언트는 UserId가 음수이고 AccountAge가 0이다.
- 사용자의 새 계정은 10/03에 만들어졌다.
features.contract:
RankingService.luau: new server module. INIT after 'AnnounceService', START before 'PlayerService'.

Seasons:
- Config.Ranking.Season = 'PRE' until beta day. The beta-day checklist line is 'Season을 B1로 바꾸고 SeasonHistory에 PRE 추가'. SeasonHistory = {'PRE'}.
- The effective season is 'STUDIO' when RunService:IsStudio() or DataService.IsMemoryMode().

Boards:
- Power: Period Season, value Rank.BestPower.
- Growth: Period Season, value Rank.BestGrowth = max(Rebirths*1000 + Level).
- Hunt: Period Week, all factions.
- Honor: Period Week, Faction Halo.
- Infamy: Period Week, Faction Horns.
- Order = {'Power','Growth','Hunt','Honor','Infamy'}.

Tuning:
- TopN = 50, RefreshSeconds = 180 staggered, WriteEverySeconds = 120, MinBudget = 5.
- MinAccountDays = 3, MinPlaySeconds = 1800.
- FairCredit = true, VictimActiveSeconds = 60, PvPMinVictimAccountDays = 7, PvPMinVictimPlaytime = 10800, MaxCreditPerVictimPerWeek = 3, MaxYieldPerVictimPerDay = 5.
- WeekCap = { Honor=150, Infamy=150, Hunt=5000 } (tune from beta logs).
- ExcludeUserIds = {}, MaxGrowthPerHour = 60, NameCacheSeconds = 3600, StudioNames = 'Player%d'.
- Config.WeekIndex(t) = math.floor((t + Config.Daily.TimezoneOffset + 3*86400) / 604800). This flips at Monday 00:00 KST (checked: 10/05 KST is week 2962).

Data (additive, Version stays 3):
- data.Rank = { Season='', BestPower=0, BestGrowth=0, WeekId=0, Honor=0, Infamy=0, Kills=0, Victims={}, YieldDay=0, YieldN=0, HideSynced=false }.
- data.DebugTainted = false.
- fillDefaults normalizes Rank:
  - Victims keys are strings 'U'..userId with integer counts 1..99, at most 100 entries.
  - Season fields reset when Rank.Season ~= the effective season.
  - Week fields reset when WeekId ~= WeekIndex(now). This also runs in the daily loop.
- BestPower and BestGrowth only rise within a season.

Stores:
- GetOrderedDataStore('HH_Rank_'..Season..'_'..Board[..'_W'..WeekId]).
- Key 'U_'..userId.
- Value = score*100 + hidden*10 + factionCode (0 None, 1 Halo, 2 Horns, 3 Neutral).

Fame funnel:
- PlayerService.GrantFame(player, stat, n, ctx) = AddStat + pcall(RankingService.Credit).
- It replaces every Honor/Infamy AddStat site.
- When ctx.PvP is set, it needs ctx.VictimUserId or ctx.Precleared.

Credit(player, board, n, ctx). It counts nothing when:
- game.PrivateServerId ~= '' (private or reserved server);
- the board's faction does not match the player's current Faction;
- WeekCap has been reached (throttled Util.Warn).

RankingService.PvPCreditOK(killer, victim). It runs at KO time and every check must pass:
1. PvPService.BoldMult(killer, victim) >= 1.
2. os.clock() - PlayerService.GetLastActive(victim) <= 60.
3. Not killer:IsFriendsWith(victim.UserId). Use pcall and a per-pair session cache; a failed call counts as friends.
4. victim.AccountAge >= 7 and the victim's PlaytimeSeconds >= 10800.
5. The killer's Rank.Victims['U'..id] < 3.
6. The victim's YieldN < 5 for today's Config.DayIndex.

On a pass, increment both counters.

Where PvPCreditOK applies:
- Plunder: HandleKO computes rankPts = (pairOk and PvPCreditOK) and PvPService.ScalePoints(1, bold) or 0. It passes this to GrudgeService.AddToSack(thief, victim, amount, infamy, rankPts), which keeps sack.RankInfamy += rankPts. pay() credits RankInfamy with ctx.Precleared. Avenged or returned sacks credit nothing. Never credit from sack.Infamy.
- payLeaveBounty passes the leaver as the victim, before the leaver's data is released.
- Hunt: the kill path credits 1 only when os.clock() - GetLastActive(player) <= 60.

These rules change ranking points only. Honor/Infamy stats, gold and stars are unchanged.

Every refusal adds its reason to RankingService.Stats.Refused[reason], for the A23-18 pre-launch abuse check.

Writes:
- Dirty set. A 10 s loop writes players whose last write was 120 s ago or more.
- Write at once on rebirth, on faction change (RemoveAsync on the old weekly board) and on PlayerLeaving.
- Skip a write when:
  - the SetIncrementSortedAsync budget is below MinBudget;
  - the value is unchanged;
  - the player is not eligible (AccountAge < 3 or Playtime < 1800);
  - DebugTainted is set;
  - the player is in ExcludeUserIds;
  - Power > Config.MaxCombatPower();
  - Growth > 999*1000 + MaxLevel;
  - BestGrowth rose by more than 20 + MaxGrowthPerHour × hours since the last write. Log these.
- BindToClose: player saves first; rankings only with leftover budget.

Hide must-write:
- AnnounceService's SetAnnounceName handler calls RankingService.MarkHideChanged(player).
- It writes every board the player has a row on as soon as budget allows, ignores the 120 s gap and retries every 10 s.
- After all writes succeed, set Rank.HideSynced = HideAnnounceName. PlayerReady re-runs this when the two differ.
- Cached rows of players in this server are re-masked from their live HideAnnounceName attribute.

Reads:
- Each board calls GetSortedAsync(false, TopN) every 180 s, staggered. Five boards make about 1.7 reads per minute.
- Read only when the GetSortedAsync budget is 2 or more.
- Cache the rows on the server. Clients read only the cache.

Names:
- Both scopes show the Roblox DisplayName, looked up with UserService:GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync (batched, pcall, 1 h cache, fallback '플레이어').
- A player who is in this server also gets the game nickname as a subtitle.
- UserId <= 0 → StudioNames.
- Hidden rows show '<진영> 한 명' with UserId 0.
- The Server scope is computed live from GetReadyPlayers with PublicName (BB37).

Remotes:
- c→s 'RequestRankings'(boardId in Order, scope 'Server'|'Global'): select('#') == 2, IsReady, RateLimits.RequestRankings = 1.
- s→c 'Rankings' { Board, Scope, Rows (≤ 50: Rank, UserId, Name, Sub, Faction, Value, Test?), Me { Rank|nil, Value, Note? }, UpdatedAt }.

Studio and tests:
- In season STUDIO, skip MinAccountDays, MinPlaySeconds and the victim age / playtime / friend checks.
- DebugCommand keys: 'RankWrite' flushes now; 'PairCD' clears the pair cooldown.
- Every DebugCommand branch sets data.DebugTainted = true. Tainted saves never write outside STUDIO, and the Server scope tags them '테스트'. tools/reset_test_save.py clears the flag.
- RankingService.Stats = { Reads, Writes, Skipped, Refused }.

Store names are deterministic (SeasonHistory × Boards × week ids), so BB40 can erase a player's rows.

features.contract:
Server:
- CombatService.DamagePlayer gets an optional 5th arg sourceKind. It is stored per victim as { Kind, At }. MonsterService passes the monster kind.
- runDeathPipeline:
  - Snapshot the victim's CarriedGold before step 1. After step 2, Lost = max(0, before - after).
  - By is chosen in this order:
    - Player: a killer exists.
    - Kaiju.
    - Monster: the last source is within 3 s.
    - Fall: no source within 3 s, and the HumanoidRootPart Y is below the zone floor - 30 or the Humanoid state is Freefall.
    - Other: everything else, including Reset Character.
  - Send owner-only Net.Fx(victim, 'KO', { By, Name = Config.MonsterTypes[kind].Name or PublicName(killer), Lost, Sack = bool, RespawnIn = Config.Player.RespawnTime }). No new remote name.

Client:
- New module DeathScreen.luau (ORDER after EventHUD). It connects its own Net 'Fx' listener filtered on kind == 'KO', bound with the FindFirstChild + timed WaitForChild pattern.
- A non-modal overlay, not a Panels window. Its ZIndex sits below Intro and the pickers.
- Closes on CharacterAdded, or RespawnIn + 2 s after showing.
- The tip comes from Config.Death.Tips by situation. The potion key comes from Keybinds.Label('PotionHP'); touch shows '물약 버튼'. By = 'Other' shows the tip '갇혔을 땐 메뉴 → 이동'.

Metrics.luau: new server module.
- Metrics.Step(player, n, name) = pcall(AnalyticsService.LogOnboardingFunnelStepEvent, AnalyticsService, player, n, name). Once per account via data.Funnel = {} (additive, Version stays 3).

Config.Analytics.Steps:
1. IntroDone
2. Faction
3. Class
4. FirstMissionAccept
5. FirstMissionDone
6. FirstWeapon
7. AutoUnlocked
8. Level10

Config.Analytics.Events:

- AutoOn.
- AutoAwayMinutes: auto ON while GetLastActive is older than 5 min, summed per session.
- EnhanceFailLeave: the player leaves within 300 s of a failed enhance.

- KeyRebind.

[순서]
1. 지금 하는 퀘스트 사슬 한 덩어리를 끝낸다. 그동안 A23-18 묶음의 '베타 개척자'는 BB16 데이터 모양(Titles·TitleSel·SetTitle)으로 바로 만든다.

problems.problem: BB17 goes against a newer user decision. The spec says the AFK auto-rest is 'not implemented yet' and makes it beta-must. In fact it was built in commit 5c977d6 and switched off in 89bf690 by user decision A23-20 (docs/SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:91-95, '계속 사냥'; Config.Combat.AutoIdleRest=false at src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.luau:394). The contract would also add a second, parallel mechanism (attribute 'Napping', Config.Afk) beside the existing AutoResting/AUTO_IDLE code (CombatService AUTO_IDLE.Check).
problems.fix: Delete BB17 from features and order, and drop '자리 비움 쉼' from summary_ko. In BB0, record P2 as superseded by A23-20. Replace it with BB17b 'Roblox 20분 무입력 퇴장 예고' (beta-must, S, client only). LocalPlayer.Idled(time) fires after 2 min idle and repeats. When time >= 17*60, show one toast per idle stretch: '3분 뒤 Roblox가 자리 비움으로 연결을 끊어요. 아무 키나 눌러 주세요' (Config.Afk.Text). Do not send fake input or use VirtualUser. Add one line about the 20-minute disconnect to the BB15 Help topic '자동 전투'. Acceptance: in Studio, firing a test Idled signal with 1020 s shows exactly 1 toast.

problems.problem: Key conflict with work already in progress. Uncommitted src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GrudgeGhost.luau:79 hardcodes Enum.KeyCode.G for A23-18 '유령으로 붙잡기'. Config.luau:2114 has the text GhostButton='유령으로 붙잡기 (G)'. The module was added to ClientMain ORDER after 'Announce'. BB1 makes G the Bag key, so after a robbery one G press would both open the bag and hold the sack. GhostHold is also missing from Config.Keybinds.Actions, so it could never be rebound. BB14 still plans an 'empty slot' for this button, but that button now exists as its own module.
problems.fix: Add action { Id='GhostHold', Group='Combat', Key='V', Pad='ButtonL3' (or nil), Label='유령으로 붙잡기' } to Config.Keybinds.Actions (or keep G for the ghost and move Bag to 'Tab-free' T). Rewire GrudgeGhost through Keybinds.ActionFor, and change GhostButton to '유령으로 붙잡기 ({GhostHold})', filled from Keybinds.Label. In ClientMain ORDER, Keybinds must come before GrudgeGhost. In BB14, delete the 'empty slot' sentence: the ghost button is shown only while alive (GrudgeGhost.active), and DeathScreen closes on CharacterAdded, so they never overlap. Add a BB1 acceptance check: in src/StarterPlayer, grep 'Enum%.KeyCode%.[A-Z]' may match only Keybinds.luau, Intro.luau (Enter/ButtonA) and WorldMap.luau (ButtonB/Escape close).

problems.problem: The sanity cap 'Power ≤ Config.CombatPower(MaxLevel, MaxWeaponTier, MaxEnhance)' is wrong. Config.MaxWeaponTier = #Config.Weapons = 8 (Config.luau:187), and tier 8 is the slime legendary with Damage 76 (Config.luau:183), not the strongest weapon. The cap works out to 7,027, while a legit Lv40 tier-7 player is at 12,516 and Lv100 T7+10 is at 25,488. The best players would be silently left off the Power board. No acceptance test catches this, because every test uses low levels.
problems.fix: Add Config.MaxCombatPower() = max over t=1..MaxWeaponTier of Config.CombatPower(Config.Levels.MaxLevel, t, Config.Loot.MaxEnhance), and use it as the cap. Add an offline acceptance check: CombatPower(100,7,10) = 25,488 passes the cap, and cap+1 is rejected. In BB4, change '무기 1→7 never decreases' to 'ordered by Config.Weapons[t].Damage (tier 8 = 76 sits between T3 and T4)'. Any code that picks the 'best weapon' by max tier index must sort by Damage instead.

problems.problem: The acceptance check '환생해도 무기를 유지하므로 전투력 순서가 그대로다' is false. CombatPower depends on level (BaseHealth and LevelDamagePerLevel). Rebirth resets Level to 1, so Lv30 T5 goes from 3,511 to 1,414. BB4 ('BestPower는 내려가지 않는다') and BB5 ('환생 때는 숫자만 바뀐다') themselves assume the drop. The check can never pass.
problems.fix: Rewrite the check: 'After rebirth, the Power column drops to the same number the HUD shows, and the player-list order follows it. The Level column is no longer the sort key.' If the user wants rebirth not to move a player down the list, the column must use BestPower. Add that as an option to user question 2.

problems.problem: The SanitizeSettings rule 'If the merged map has a duplicate key, Keys = {}' wipes every custom bind whenever a new default collides with a player's sparse rebinds. That will happen within this same beta: BB18 adds Journal=J, GhostHold needs a key, and Z/X/pet keys come later. A player who moved Attack to J would silently lose all their keys. The spec also has no 'unbound' state to fall back to.
problems.fix: Allow Key = '' (unbound) in Actions, and show it in the UI as '없음'. Resolve duplicates deterministically, without a wipe: entries the user set always win, and a default-only action whose default key is taken becomes ''. The client toasts once: '새 동작 [일지]의 기본 키 J가 이미 쓰여서 비워 뒀어요 → 설정에서 정해 주세요'. Add an acceptance check: a save with Keys={Attack='J'} loads after Journal=J is added, Attack stays J, and Journal becomes unbound.

problems.problem: Changes can be lost to the rate limit. The client sends 1 s after the last change and again when the window closes. Util.RateLimit (Util.luau:114-124) refuses a second call inside 1 s, and the spec has the server echo the older stored table, which the client then accepts ('server value wins'). Example: change a key, the send goes at t=1.0, close the window at t=1.3; that second send is refused and the last change is undone.
problems.fix: Client: keep one pending blob and send at max(now, lastSent + RateLimits.SetSettings + 0.05). Never send twice inside the limit, and on close flush through the same scheduler. Add a sequence field Seq (an integer the server clamps). The server echoes {Seq, Settings}, and the client ignores echoes with Seq lower than its newest pending Seq. On a rate-limit refusal the server sends nothing; it echoes only on a validation refusal. Also add a client pull at Start (SetSettings with no args = 'send me mine', still rate-limited) so the one-time PlayerReady echo can't be lost.

problems.problem: BB27 duplicates and contradicts uncommitted work in progress. GrudgeService now has MAIL.Send/MAIL.Receive, using its own store Config.Grudge.MailStore='HaloHorns_GrudgeMail_v1' (Config.luau:686), at most 20 letters, and pays automatically into the bank at join (Text GrudgeMail). Its comment says 'cleared first, so a crash can lose but never double-pay'. BB27 instead specifies a new MailService with 'HaloHorns_Mail_v1', a ClaimMail remote, a 우편 menu and two-phase delete-after-save. Its acceptance check '저장이 실패해도 골드가 사라지거나 두 번 들어오지 않는다' fails against the implementation being built.
problems.fix: Rewrite BB27 to match the GrudgeService MAIL implementation (no ClaimMail, no menu entry; the BB19 notification log keeps the GrudgeMail text). Either accept 'may lose on crash, never double-pays' as the rule (write that in the acceptance text), or require the safer order: mark letters as claimed in data.MailClaimed with their ids, save the player, then delete them from the store. Decide one and record it in TECH_SPEC §4.14.

problems.problem: The ranking acceptance checks cannot pass in the documented test setup. RELEASE_PLAN.md:67 runs multi-player tests with Studio local clients (UserId -1/-2/-3, AccountAge 0, so GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync fails for negative ids). Those clients fail MinAccountDays=3 and PvPMinVictimAccountDays=7, so '3명 테스트: 2분 안에 저장…3분 안에 [전체]' and 'same victim 4th KO' never write or credit anything. PairRewardCooldown=300 also makes 4 KOs take more than 15 min. The user's own new account (created around 10-03, after the suspension) is under 3 days old until 10-06 and under 7 until 10-10, so real-server tests fail as well.
problems.fix: Add Config.Ranking.StudioBypass = true. When the season is 'STUDIO', skip MinAccountDays, MinPlaySeconds and PvPMinVictimAccountDays, and use Config.Ranking.StudioNames for UserId <= 0 instead of calling UserService. Add DebugCommand keys 'RankWrite' (force flush) and 'PairCD' (clear the pair cooldown). Expose RankingService.Stats = {Reads, Writes, Skipped} so the '10번 눌러도 읽기 수 불변' check can be measured. Keep one real-server check for the user, after 10-10, with 2 accounts aged 7 days or more.

problems.problem: One of the three playable factions has no weekly ranking. FactionPicker offers Halo/Horns/Neutral (FactionPicker.luau:29, '장인 길드'), but the weekly boards are Honor (Halo) and Infamy (Horns) only. Neutral players see only the all-time Power and Growth boards, and BB26 gives the Halo castle and Horns den boards but nothing to the guild. This weakens GDD §0, where every choice has a consequence.
problems.fix: Add a weekly board that every faction can enter, using data that already exists: Week.Kills, counted only within 60 s of manual activity (pulled forward from BB36). Or add a Neutral-only weekly board (e.g., gold earned from Sale/craft, capped). Add it to Config.Ranking.Order. The budget allows it (about 1.7 reads/min). Otherwise ask the user explicitly.

problems.problem: '원하는대로' (rebind however I want) is only partly delivered. Allowed covers only A–Z and 0–9, so F1–F8, keypad digits, LeftControl, LeftAlt, CapsLock and keys such as ; ' [ ] , - = \ are all refused. There is no 'unbind'. Gamepad remapping and the phone button layout (the phone version of key settings) are pushed to launch (BB21/BB34) without asking the user, yet Roblox is phone-heavy and the user asked for it before beta.
problems.fix: Extend Allowed to F1–F8, Keypad0–Keypad9, Minus, Equals, LeftBracket, RightBracket, Semicolon, Quote, Comma, BackSlash, LeftControl, LeftAlt and CapsLock, then check each one in a Studio Play (keys Roblox swallows go into Reserved). Add a [비우기] button per row. Add user question 4: '폰 버튼 위치·크기 바꾸기와 패드 키 바꾸기는 정식(12/19)으로 미뤄도 될까요? 베타엔 PC 키보드만 원하는 대로 됩니다.' If the user says no, move the BB34 UiScale (보통/크게) row and a left-hand mirror toggle into beta-must (S).

problems.problem: The cut-down goes against the user's rule. A23-19 (docs/SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:97-101) and the request itself say that other basics missing from the list must also be done before beta. The spec labels 12 basics beta-should (quest log, notification log, gamepad, BGM/SFX, friend invite, first-time hints…) and 7 launch, and says 'if not done by 10/24 → launch'. The user is never asked about these items; the questions cover only ④ ranking and ⑤ 3D preview.
problems.fix: Add to user_questions one line listing the beta-should items that may slip (BB18 일지, BB19 알림 기록, BB21 패드, BB23 음악, BB24 첫 안내, BB25 초대, BB26 명예의 전당, BB28 상대 표시, BB29 언어). Ask whether they may slip past beta or whether something else (Z skill / Halloween count) goes first. In schedule_fit_ko, keep the 10/20 cut order with BB-should items explicitly placed before or after Z.

problems.problem: Basics are missing with no explicit out-of-scope list. The user asked the team to find the basics they forgot, but the spec never says which typical RPG basics were considered and rejected, so the user cannot judge whether it is complete. Absent with no stated reason: party/group (GDD.md:450 '이후'), trade (idea_backlog:25, auction at launch), armor/accessory slots (BB8 hides them), skill levels/points, guild, minimap (A12), faction chat (Teams exist, so RBXTeam /t already works), monster book (P7, partly covered by Items.Sources).
problems.fix: Add a section '베타에 안 넣는 기본 기능과 이유' to docs/design/beta_basics_2026-10-05.md, one line each: 파티(정식 이후 GDD:450), 1:1 거래(사기 방지, 경매장 정식 A23-13), 갑옷·장신구 칸(설계 없음 — 사용자에게 물음), 스킬 레벨·포인트(설계 없음), 길드(이후), 미니맵(A12), 진영 채팅(/t로 이미 됨 → BB15 도움말에 한 줄), 도감(P7 글자 표만). Ask one question about armor slots, because an equipment window with only a weapon slot may not match the user's idea of '장비창'.

problems.problem: The bag's only sell action is '모두 팔기'. The existing remote sells every material (LootService.luau:416-438), including Fine-grade SlimeCore, BruteHorn and KnightCrest. Config says 'crafting comes with the full launch' (Config.luau Loot comment), and A23-18 keeps beta saves into launch. One tap destroys future crafting materials without a confirmation, and a basic inventory normally lets you sell a chosen item and quantity.
problems.fix: Add c→s 'SellItem'(itemId: string ≤ 32 chars that is a Material in Config.Loot.Items, n: integer 1..held). Use the same anvil check (ShopService.CanBuyWeapon), RateLimits.SellItem = 0.3, and 'remove before pay'. In the bag detail pane, add [팔기] with a quantity stepper. Make '모두 팔기' sell only Common materials, ask once to confirm ('젤리 12, 이빨 5 → 84골드'), and exclude Fine+ materials (Config.Loot.Items[id].Grade ≠ 'Common'). Add an acceptance check: after 모두 팔기, 왕 슬라임 핵 stays in the bag.

problems.problem: The beta analytics funnel (P6) is not in the spec, even though A23-20 says AFK and other decisions will be revisited from 'P6 퍼널' data and mmorpg_painpoints P6 is due before feature freeze. AnalyticsService is used nowhere in src (grep returns 0). A beta with no metrics cannot answer the questions it is run for.
problems.fix: Add BB-P6 (beta-must, S, server only): AnalyticsService:LogOnboardingFunnelStepEvent for opening skip / faction / first mission accept / first mission done / first weapon / first death cause, plus LogCustomEvent for auto ON, enhance fail→leave within 5 min, and bag/skill/character/ranking window opens. No personal data. Use event names from Config.Analytics, and wrap every call in pcall. Acceptance: in Studio, each event logs once per account, with no errors.

problems.problem: CamSens multiplies only CameraFollow RADIANS_PER_PIXEL (CameraFollow.luau:17), which is the custom left-drag. Right-drag, touch and gamepad camera stay with Roblox's PlayerModule (CameraFollow.luau:2-3). The slider does nothing on phones, and on PC left-drag and right-drag turn at different speeds, yet the spec says '기타 설정은 모두 동작한다' on phones.
problems.fix: Remove CamSens. Multiply left-drag by UserSettings():GetService('UserGameSettings').MouseSensitivity so Roblox's own Esc-menu sensitivity controls both drags. Or keep CamSens but label it '마우스 왼쪽 끌기 감도' and hide it when TouchEnabled and not KeyboardEnabled.

problems.problem: Window hotkeys don't toggle. HUD onInputBegan returns early when inputAllowed() is false, which is the case while a Panels window is open (HUD.luau:2963-2970). Pressing G again in the bag, or C while the bag is open, does nothing, and only Menu (B) is special-cased. Esc closes the map (WorldMap.luau:1350) but not Panels.
problems.fix: Handle Group 'Window' actions before the inputAllowed() check, using the same pattern as the B rule. If Panels.CurrentId() == target, close it; otherwise call Panels.Open(target), switching windows. Also close the open Panels window on GuiService.MenuOpened (Esc), to match WorldMap. Add an acceptance check: G opens and G closes the bag; C while the bag is open switches to the character window.

problems.problem: Edge cases in the swap rule and the interact key. (a) Swapping with a hidden action (SkillZ while ZEnabled=false) moves the old key to an invisible row. (b) If client KeyboardKeyCode is ignored and the row becomes '고정 E', E stays in Allowed, so Attack=E would attack and trigger prompts together. (c) WorldMap.luau:148 HintMouse 'M / Esc: 닫기' is a hardcoded key string missing from the rewire list. (d) Line citations have drifted: Config is src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.luau, with :1156→:1164, :1313→:1321, :1463→:1471 and :580→:587.
problems.fix: (a) Hidden actions take part in no swaps and hold no key; when one is enabled and its default key is taken, it becomes '' (see the BB2 fix). (b) In '고정 E' mode, add E to the Reserved set at runtime. (c) Change WorldMap HintMouse to '{Map} / Esc: 닫기', filled from Keybinds.Label. (d) Use grep anchors such as 'Unlocked = "자동 전투가 열렸어요' instead of line numbers.

problems.problem: The acceptance checks miss the known HUD collision. visual_direction_2026-10-05.md:809 records that the EventHUD top-right luck panel (210×58) collides with the [가방][지도][메뉴] rail at 749×361, and BB7 widens the rail to 4 squares (auto + bag + map + menu).
problems.fix: Add an acceptance check: at 749×361 and 1280×720, AbsolutePosition/AbsoluteSize rectangles of the HUD right row, the EventHUD luck panel and the quest panel do not intersect (measured with execute_luau, not by eye). If they do, move luck into the chip line under the war meter, as line 809 proposes.

problems.problem: Some fields are named but not defined. 'Lost = carried gold lost' has no source: HandleKO, HandleNonPvPDeath and Grudge do not return amounts (CombatService.luau:1082-1110). By='Fall' has no detection rule, and Roblox Reset Character deaths are not covered.
problems.fix: In runDeathPipeline, snapshot the victim's carried gold before step 1 and set Lost = before − after once step 2 is done. Fall: no damage source in the last 3 s, and the HumanoidRootPart Y is under the zone's floor minus 30 or the Humanoid state is Freefall. Reset (Health set to 0 with no source) → By='Other', with the tip '갇혔을 땐 메뉴 → 이동'.

problems.problem: Hiding the name may never reach the boards. A row is written only when it is dirty and its value changed, and toggling SetAnnounceName does not mark the boards dirty. Separately, the private published place used for testing writes season 'B1' from real servers, so pre-beta test scores will sit on the beta boards.
problems.fix: In AnnounceService's SetAnnounceName handler, call RankingService.MarkDirty(player, 'All'). Make Config.Ranking.Season = 'PRE' until beta, and add a beta-day checklist line: 'Season을 B1로 바꾸고 게시'.

problems.problem: Gamepad acceptance cannot be checked with the available tools: Studio MCP user_keyboard_input has no gamepad input. BB20's [차단] and BB25's invite prompt also do not appear in Studio.
problems.fix: Expose Keybinds.Dispatch(fakeInput {KeyCode, UserInputType}) and test the pad mappings by calling it from execute_luau. Mark the physical-pad check, the block prompt and the invite prompt as '사용자 실기기 확인' in the acceptance lists.

problems.problem: The help text Config.Power.Text.PvPNote ('PvP 피해는 전투력 차이가 커도 최대 1.5배예요') is inaccurate. The PvP damage ratio is the attacker/victim WeaponDamage ratio clamped to 0.8–1.5 (CombatService.luau:412-418), not the 전투력 ratio, so two players with the same 전투력 but different level/weapon mixes get different ratios.
problems.fix: Change it to '무기 공격력 차이가 커도 PvP 피해는 최대 1.5배, 최소 0.8배예요'.

problems.problem: While ZEnabled=false, the skill window has only 2 rows (basic attack + Q). It will look empty next to what users expect from a '스킬창', and class traits and faction perks are hidden in the BB8 stats tab.
problems.fix: Add a read-only '패시브' section to SkillBook: class Stats lines (Config.Classes), faction Perks (Config.Factions), and FallMarks/RedeemMarks effects, all from Config. This uses no new data and no unlock teasers.

missing_features: Roblox 20-minute idle disconnect warning (LocalPlayer.Idled toast at about 17 min). Replaces BB17, which goes against A23-20.
Config.Keybinds action for the in-progress GrudgeGhost hold key (currently hardcoded G, which collides with Bag G).
Unbound/empty key state plus a [비우기] button, and deterministic resolution when a new default key collides with saved binds (no full wipe).
Wider rebindable key set (F1–F8, keypad, punctuation, Ctrl/Alt/CapsLock) to meet '원하는대로'.
Window hotkeys that toggle (press again to close, press another to switch) and Esc closing Panels like WorldMap.
Per-item material sell with quantity, plus confirmation, with Fine+ crafting materials excluded from '모두 팔기' (beta saves carry into launch, and crafting comes at launch).
Weekly ranking board for the Neutral (장인 길드) faction, or one all-faction weekly board.
AnalyticsService beta funnel (P6), which A23-20 relies on for later decisions.
Studio test bypass for ranking eligibility (AccountAge, playtime, negative test UserIds), debug flush/pair-cooldown commands, and RankingService.Stats counters.
Ranking season 'PRE' before beta, switched to 'B1' on beta day (checklist line).
Explicit '베타에 안 넣는 기본 기능' list (party, trade, armor/accessory slots, skill points, guild, minimap, monster book, faction chat via /t) and a user question about armor slots.
User question on phone button layout/size and gamepad remapping for beta vs launch (the phone/pad side of key settings).
User question listing which beta-should basics may slip past 10/31 (A23-19 makes extra basics beta-required).
Client pull for saved Settings at Start (do not rely only on the one-time PlayerReady echo).
Acceptance grep check that no hardcoded Enum.KeyCode letters remain outside Keybinds/Intro/WorldMap close.
Passive section (class/faction/mark effects) in the skill window.
crits.overall:
The spec is thorough and covers all six requested items (skill window, bag, equipment window, combat power, ranking, key settings) with server-side checks. Three things block it as written:
1. **BB17 is overruled by a newer decision.** It brings back the AFK auto-rest that A23-20 switched off (commits 5c977d6 and 89bf690, AutoIdleRest = false).
2. **The G key is taken twice.** GrudgeGhost.luau, which is uncommitted work in progress, uses G, and BB1 also makes G the bag key.
3. **The ranking power cap is wrong.** BB10 computes the cap with MaxWeaponTier = 8, but tier 8 is the 76-damage jelly weapon. The cap comes out at 7,027 and leaves every tier-7 player off the power board.

Next most important:
- BB27 clashes with the grudge-mail code now being written. Its 'never lost or doubled' acceptance check does not match that code.
- BB12's 'order unchanged after rebirth' check is false, because rebirth resets level and combat power drops.
- If a new default key collides with a player's saved keys, the settings clean-up wipes all of their keys.
- The 1-second rate limit can undo the player's last settings change.
- The ranking acceptance tests cannot pass in Studio, where test clients have account age 0 and negative UserIds. They also cannot pass soon on the user's new account, which is under 3 days old until 10/06 and under 7 days old until 10/10.

**Completeness:**
- **Key settings:** only letters and digits on the PC keyboard, with no way to unbind a key. Phone and gamepad remapping are moved to launch without asking the user.
- **Factions:** the Neutral faction gets no weekly ranking.
- **Bag:** it can only sell all materials at once, including materials needed for crafting at launch, and beta saves carry over to launch.
- **Missing items:**
  - the P6 analytics funnel, which A23-20 depends on;
  - a warning before Roblox's 20-minute idle disconnect;
  - a list of the basic features deliberately left out.
- **Scope:** A23-19 makes the extra basics beta-required, but about 12 of them are marked beta-should/launch without a user question.

Fix the three blockers and add the missing user questions before workers start BB1, BB2, BB10 or BB27. The other items are small contract edits.

problems.problem: This item contradicts a newer user decision and duplicates code that has already shipped. A23-20 (uncommitted, docs/SPEC_ADDENDUM.md ~line 91, commit 89bf690 '자리 비움 쉬기 끄기(사용자 결정: 계속 사냥)') says auto combat keeps hunting while the player is away, and it switches the idle rest off with Config.Combat.AutoIdleRest = false (Config.luau:394). The rest mechanic is also already built under different names: commit 5c977d6 added Config.Combat.AutoIdleSeconds/AutoIdleWarnSeconds/AutoIdleMoveStuds (Config.luau:391-394), the AutoResting attribute (CombatService.luau:632-683, 1273-1278), MonsterService skipping resting players (MonsterService.luau:1328, 1621) and walking counted as activity (PlayerService.luau:590-600, at 1.5 studs). BB17's Config.Afk, 'Napping', ZoneService 4-stud sampling and CharacterVisuals Zzz would add a second, conflicting system and turn a mechanic back on that the user switched off.
problems.fix: Delete BB17 from the beta list. In BB0, add a line saying P2 is superseded by A23-20. If you keep any note at all, reference only the existing names (AutoIdleRest, AutoResting, ChoicePending). Remove 'Napping' from BB8's active-effects list.

problems.problem: Grudge mail is already being built differently in the worker's uncommitted tree. GrudgeService has MAIL.Send/MAIL.Receive on DataStore Config.Grudge.MailStore = 'HaloHorns_GrudgeMail_v1' (Config.luau ~684-686, GrudgeService.luau ~137-196). It deposits to the bank automatically at join and shows the notice 'GrudgeMail'. It clears the mailbox first and pays after, so a crash can lose a payment but never double-pay. BB27 instead specifies a new MailService, a store named 'HaloHorns_Mail_v1', data.Mail, a 'ClaimMail' remote and a menu '우편' entry. Building both gives two stores and two remotes, and the BB27 acceptance line ('골드가 사라지지 않는다') contradicts the worker's chosen trade-off.
problems.fix: Remove BB27 from this spec and point to the GrudgeService MAIL implementation (P3 + A23-18 ghost hold). If a claim UI is still wanted later, make it a launch item that reads the same 'HaloHorns_GrudgeMail_v1' store. Do not add a ClaimMail remote or a MailService.

problems.problem: The G key is already taken. The new client module GrudgeGhost.luau (now in ClientMain ORDER after 'Announce') hardcodes Enum.KeyCode.G (GrudgeGhost.luau:78-79), and Config.Text.GhostButton reads '유령으로 붙잡기 (G)' (Config.luau ~2114). BB1 makes Bag = G. Pressing G after respawn while my sack is open would then open the Bag (a full-screen Panels window that blocks input) and fire GhostHold at the same moment. BB1's current_state also lists only 4 files with hardcoded keys; there are now 5.
problems.fix: Add { Id='GhostHold', Group='Combat', Key='T', Pad='ButtonX'? (or nil) } to Config.Keybinds.Actions. Route GrudgeGhost through Keybinds.ActionFor and drop the KeyCode.G literal. Change GhostButton to '유령으로 붙잡기 ({GhostHold})' and fill it with Keybinds.Label('GhostHold'). Keep Bag = G. Add GrudgeGhost.luau to BB1's rewire list, and to the acceptance line '기본 키 … 회귀 0'.

problems.problem: The sanity cap rejects legitimate players. Config.MaxWeaponTier = #Config.Weapons = 8 (Config.luau:187), and tier 8 is the slime legendary with Damage 76, which is lower than tier 4 (88) and far below tier 7 (1000) (Config.luau:172-185). Config.CombatPower(MaxLevel, MaxWeaponTier, MaxEnhance) is therefore 7,027. A real Lv40 T6 +10 player has 8,860 and Lv100 T7 +10 has 25,488, so their Power scores would fail 'Power ≤ cap' and never be written.
problems.fix: Use cap = max over t = 1..Config.MaxWeaponTier of Config.CombatPower(Config.Levels.MaxLevel, t, Config.Loot.MaxEnhance), computed once at Init (25,488 today). Add an offline test that equips tiers 1..8 at +10 / Lv100 and asserts each value ≤ cap. Apply the same max-over-tiers rule anywhere 'MaxWeaponTier' is used to mean 'strongest'.

problems.problem: The settings sync can silently undo a player's change. Util.RateLimit drops a second call inside the interval (Util.luau:114-125), and the contract says the server echoes the stored Settings on any refusal and that the server value wins on the client. Scenario: the player changes Sfx, and the debounced send goes out at t=1.0. The player then flips Shake and closes the window at t=1.5, so the close-send is rate-limited (RateLimits.SetSettings = 1). The server echoes the old blob, and the client adopts it, so the Shake change is lost without any message. The current Panels code already documents that the server 'drops … WITHOUT a reply' (Panels.luau:1844-1847).
problems.fix: Client: one outbound slot with ReadyAt = lastSent + RateLimits.SetSettings + ITEMS.GapMargin (the same pattern as ITEMS.Send, Panels.luau:1954-1991). Always send the latest blob at max(now, ReadyAt), and send on close only through that slot. Add Seq to the payload (blob.Seq integer). The server echoes {Settings, Seq}, and the client ignores echoes whose Seq is older than its last sent Seq. Server: on a rate-limit drop, send no echo (house rule). Echo only after a validation clean-up that changed values.

problems.problem: 'If the merged map has a duplicate key, Keys = {}' erases all of a player's rebinds whenever a default changes. This will happen during beta: BB18 adds Journal = J, the GhostHold action is new, and SkillZ (Z) becomes live when ZEnabled flips at 10/20. Example: a player who bound Attack to J loses every custom key the day Journal ships, and nothing tells them.
problems.fix: Allow the value 'None' (unbound) in Keys. In SanitizeSettings, a key the player set explicitly beats a colliding default: the default action becomes 'None' (and stays sparse-stored as 'None'). Wipe only entries that are invalid themselves. The Settings key tab shows '키 없음' rows highlighted. Flag-hidden actions such as SkillZ keep their default key reserved, so enabling the flag cannot collide.

problems.problem: Panels.Register as specced breaks the new windows in three ways. (1) No arg pass-through: render() calls BUILDERS[currentId](content) with only the parent (Panels.luau:2798), and Open's arg is used only for Story, so Panels.Open('Settings',{Tab='Keys'}) and a board 'OpenPanel Ranking' with a tab never reach the window. (2) REBUILD_ATTRS (Panels.luau:24) contains HideAnnounceName, Faction and Class, and any change does a full queueRebuild() (Panels.luau:3020-3021). Toggling name-hide inside Settings (BB3 moves it there) therefore rebuilds Settings: the tab resets, the scroll is lost, and an active key capture survives without its UI. A Faction/Class change rebuilds the Character window and recreates its ViewportFrame. (3) Registered windows have no close or rebuild hook, so BB3's 'always Unbind on close' cannot be implemented: Panels.Close only clears content (Panels.luau:2892-2907).
problems.fix: Use Register(id, { Build = fn(parent, kit, arg), Title, FixedBody, Rebuild = { attr = true } | false, Cleanup = fn() }). In Panels.Open, store RENDER.Arg = arg. render() passes it through and calls the previous window's Cleanup before clearContent. Panels.Close calls Cleanup. For registered windows, REBUILD_ATTRS applies only when opts.Rebuild lists the attribute, and windows refresh themselves through kit.OnAttr. Keep tab state in the module, not in the builder closure. Keybinds.Capture is cancelled in SettingsUI's Cleanup.

problems.problem: The 'beta-must' list does not fit, and the spec defers the cut to 10/20, when it is too late to recover. BB0-BB16 is about 15 days by the spec's own count. crits.overall: The direction is sound: separate modules registered through Panels, one integer CombatPower, a central key map, additive Version-3 fields, and an OrderedDataStore with a server cache and a STUDIO season. Most of the code claims check out against the source: the PowerOf samples (283/387/758/1,052/2,829 reproduce exactly), the GetCombatPower/BoldMult wiring, fillDefaults behaviour, the WorldMap priority of 3010, the HUD/Fx/Panels local counts (about 144/171/139; WorldMap is at about 176, so it is also tight), the leaderstats order and the remote names. The spec is out of date in three places, though. BB17 contradicts A23-20 ('계속 사냥', AutoIdleRest = false) and duplicates shipped code. BB27 duplicates the grudge mail being built right now in GrudgeService. The new GrudgeGhost.luau already owns the G key that BB1 gives to the Bag. Real bugs to fix before handing it off: the BB10 sanity cap uses tier 8 (7,027) and would reject legitimate players; the BB2 rate-limit echo can silently revert settings; the BB2 duplicate-key rule wipes every rebind when a default changes; Panels.Register has no arg pass-through, no Cleanup hook and is caught by the REBUILD_ATTRS full rebuilds; Week.Victims needs string keys; debug or Studio values can reach the real boards, and the eligibility gates make Studio testing of the global boards impossible. On schedule, roughly 15 'must' days on top of Z, pets, Halloween and the step-6 redesign does not fit in about 19 days. Cut now, not at 10/20: keep the user's six requests in minimal form (about 9 days, skip the BB6 refactor, BB8 without the 3D body, rankings without the Growth board), add the P6 analytics funnel, demote BB14/15/16 polish to 'should' (send BB16's data shape to the worker now, since they are doing the A23-18 bundle), delete BB17 and BB27, and schedule the basics right after the current quest-chain chunk, ahead of Z.

It shipped in commit 5c977d6 (CombatService AUTO_IDLE.Check, around :667-693, attribute 'AutoResting', not 'Napping') and is switched off on purpose. Building BB17 would turn it back on against AGENTS precedence rule 1. There is a safety side effect too: auto attacks hit monsters only (A23-1), so AFK hunters in Goblin Woods / Skeleton Ruins (PvP = true, Config.luau:924/927) cannot fight back and become free plunder and free ranking points.

problems.problem: The weekly 명예/악명 boards are in practice PvP-kill leaderboards, so they reward griefing kids. Story points are one-time and small (Points 1-2, Config.luau:1205/1256/1312; goose first-time 1). Repeatable points come only from PvP: about 1 per KO via ScalePoints(1, bold) (PvPService.luau:613, :633), max(1, stars) via :649 and :856, and Honor ×2 for strong victims. The spec's filters leave large gaps. (a) BoldWeak KOs (victim at 50-80% of my power) still score ×0.5. (b) Roblox friends can trade kills ('죽여 줄게'), which is the most common kid collusion. (c) AFK auto-hunters (A23-20) count. (d) PvPMinVictimAccountDays = 7 does nothing in practice: alts made today are 26 days old at beta. (e) The per-victim cap is per killer only, so one weak kid can feed every Horns player in the server. (f) WeekCap = 1000 never binds at 1-10 points per KO.
problems.fix:
Add RankingService.PvPCreditOK(killer, victim) -> bool. Call it at KO time in PvPService.HandleKO and payLeaveBounty, before any Credit. All of these must hold:
1. PvPService.BoldMult(killer, victim) >= 1, so only fair or upward fights count.
2. os.clock() - PlayerService.GetLastActive(victim) <= Config.Ranking.VictimActiveSeconds (60).
3. not killer:IsFriendsWith(victim.UserId). Use pcall and a per-pair session cache; a failed call counts as friends, which means no credit.
4. victim.AccountAge >= 7 and victim PlaytimeSeconds >= Config.Ranking.PvPMinVictimPlaytime (10800).
5. Killer-side Week.Victims[victimId] < 3.
6. Victim-side yield cap: data.Week.Yield < Config.Ranking.MaxYieldPerVictimPerDay (5), keyed by Config.DayIndex and stored in the victim's save.

Also:
- Set WeekCap = { Honor = 150, Infamy = 150 } until beta logs exist.
- Log every refused credit with its reason (Util.Warn throttled) for the A23-18 pre-launch abuse check.
- These rules change only ranking points. Honor/Infamy stats, gold and stars stay as they are.

problems.problem: Infamy from plunder bypasses every per-victim check. The thief's Infamy is summed across victims into sack.Infamy (GrudgeService.luau:324) and paid as one number in pay() (GrudgeService.luau:204-207), after the victim identity is gone. Calling RankingService.Credit 'next to every AddStat' at GrudgeService:207 therefore cannot apply victim AccountAge, friend, active or per-victim caps. An alt farm through the sack gets full weekly Infamy credit.
problems.fix:
Decide ranking eligibility at steal time, where the victim is known:
- In PvPService.HandleKO, compute rankPts = PvPCreditOK(killer, victim) and pairOk and PvPService.ScalePoints(1, bold) or 0.
- Pass rankPts as a new 5th argument: GrudgeService.AddToSack(killer, victim, stolen, infamy, rankPts), stored as sack.RankInfamy += rankPts. Record Week.Victims and the victim's Yield at that moment.
- In pay(), call RankingService.Credit(thief, 'Infamy', sack.RankInfamy, { Precleared = true }).
- Avenged or returned sacks credit nothing.
- Never credit from sack.Infamy directly.

problems.problem: Developer and test accounts will top the global boards, and the season reset does not reset Power. Studio with API access writes the real player DataStore: memory mode is used only when the probe fails (DataService.luau:271-281). DebugCommand (Main.server.luau:54, Studio only) sets Level and Gold, and those values persist. A23-18 keeps beta saves to launch (SPEC_ADDENDUM.md:105-107). BestPower and BestGrowth are all-time fields in player data and 'never go down'. So 'Season = STUDIO' only protects the stores. The next live join of the debug-boosted dev account writes an impossible BestPower to B1, and changing Season to L1 re-posts every beta BestPower. 'Change Season to reset' is false for the Power and Growth boards.
problems.fix:
1. Make the ranking fields season-scoped: Data.Defaults.Rank = { Season = '', BestPower = 0, BestGrowth = 0 }. fillDefaults / RankingService resets it when Rank.Season ~= Config.Ranking.Season. Studio sessions write Rank.Season = 'STUDIO', which resets on the next live join. Version stays 3; the change is additive.
2. Add a persisted data.DebugTainted = true. Every DebugCommand branch sets it. RankingService never writes a global row for a tainted save; the Server scope shows it with a '테스트' tag.
3. Add Config.Ranking.ExcludeUserIds = { <owner>, <test accounts> }.
4. Add a plausibility check: skip and log a write if BestGrowth rose by more than Config.Ranking.MaxLevelsPerHour × hours played since the last write.

Drop the weak marker and keep only the gold '센 상대 ×2' marker, which encourages fighting upward.

Add a server-side pre-KO warning:

problems.problem: Config.Power.Text.BullyNote ('상대 전투력이 내 절반 미만이면 깡패예요') is over-simplified. 8-14-year-olds will read it as 'anyone at 50% or more is fair game', but repeat KOs (3 in 10 min) and fresh-spawn KOs (15 s) also make the attacker a 깡패 (Config.luau:598-609).
problems.fix: BullyNote = '약한 상대(내 전투력 절반 미만), 막 부활한 상대(15초 안), 같은 상대를 10분에 3번 쓰러뜨리면 깡패예요'. Add the same three lines to the BB15 Help topic '새싹 보호·깡패'. Write them as one Config.Bully.Text table shared by BB8, BB15 and BB28.

problems.problem: A request to hide a name can be silently delayed or dropped. The hidden flag lives in the encoded value, but writes are skipped when the budget is below MinBudget, when the player is not eligible, or inside the 120 s write gap. A hide toggle is not listed among the immediate writes, and the PlayerLeaving write can also be skipped for budget. A child who turns hiding on can stay named on the global boards for a whole session or longer. Other servers' caches (180 s) add more delay.
problems.fix:
Make a hide toggle a must-write:
- AnnounceService onSetName calls RankingService.MarkHideChanged(player).
- That writes every board the player is on (Power, Growth, current-week board) as soon as the budget allows. It ignores the 120 s gap and retries every 10 s until it succeeds.
- It persists data.RankHideSynced = HideAnnounceName only after all writes succeed. PlayerReady re-runs it when RankHideSynced ~= HideAnnounceName.
- When serving cached rows, the local server re-masks the rows of players currently in this server from their live HideAnnounceName attribute, so the change shows instantly here.
- Acceptance: 'hide ON → this server's [전체] row masked within 1 s; other servers within RefreshSeconds + 10 s'.

problems.problem: Ranking credit sites are incomplete and their line numbers have already moved. current_state says 6 AddStat sites, but there are 7: PvPService.luau:613, :633, :649 and :856 (payLeaveBounty), GrudgeService.luau:207, and StoryQuestService.luau:488 and :527. The worker is editing these files right now, so the cited numbers (553/571/586/785) are stale. payLeaveBounty, the Honor paid when a combat-tagged Horns logs out, has no KO. If its ctx has no VictimUserId, an alt that logs out repeatedly feeds weekly Honor with no cap.
problems.fix: Add one helper, PlayerService.GrantFame(player, stat, n, ctx), that does AddStat and RankingService.Credit together. Replace all 7 sites with it, so no site is missed when lines move. ctx.VictimUserId is required whenever ctx.PvP == true, and Credit refuses a PvP credit without it. payLeaveBounty passes the leaver's UserId and goes through PvPCreditOK.

problems.problem: Roblox right-to-erasure: the feature adds personal data keyed by UserId across a growing number of stores. Each week creates a new 'HH_Rank_<Season>_<Store>_W<n>' store, BB27 adds 'HaloHorns_Mail_v1', and Week.Victims stores other players' UserIds. No erasure procedure exists anywhere in the repo (grep for erasure/GDPR/삭제 요청 finds nothing in docs, src or tools). Roblox sends developers right-to-erasure requests and expects every store keyed by that user to be cleared.
problems.fix:
Add docs/ops/data_erasure.md and tools/erase_user.py (Open Cloud, run by the user). Given a UserId, it does three things:
- Removes the main save key and the nickname directory and claim.
- RemoveAsync of 'U_<id>' in every ranking store, enumerated from the deterministic names: each Season in Config.Ranking.SeasonHistory × the Boards × the week indexes from the season start to now.
- Removes the mail key.

Also:
- Keep Week.Victims at 100 keys or fewer and clear it at the weekly reset (as specced).
- Add Config.Ranking.SeasonHistory so the tool knows the old season names.
- Effort S, beta-must, because the global boards go live at the beta.

problems.problem: The Tab list is a public target list either way. Today the gold column is bank + carried (PlayerService.luau:297) and points to rich plunder victims. A Power-sorted list puts the weakest kids at the bottom. HideAnnounceName cannot hide Roblox's own Tab names, but the new setting label '알림·랭킹에 내 이름 숨기기' may make kids think it does.
problems.fix: Keep the user question about the gold column; Power is still the lesser risk. Also add a third option to that question: Columns = {'Level','Rebirths','Fame'} with no gold and no power. Add a one-line note under the hide setting: '플레이어 목록(Tab)의 로블록스 이름은 숨길 수 없어요'.

problems.problem: Tags = 'Off' hides other players' BillboardGui 'Nametag'. That tag also carries the 새싹, 깡패 and wanted-star bits (CharacterVisuals.luau:285-298). A child who turns tags off in a PvP zone loses the warnings that someone near them is a bully or a wanted player.
problems.fix: Tags 'Off' / 'Near' hide only the name lines. While I am in a PvP zone or combat-tagged, the bully, wanted and rookie bits stay visible on players within 40 studs. Implement this in the client tag filter, with no server change.

problems.problem: Global rows show the Roblox DisplayName and headshot, while everywhere else in the game uses the filtered game nickname (NicknameService.luau:224-225 broadcast filter, Util.PlayerDisplayName). A child who picked a nickname to stay pseudonymous is linked to their Roblox identity on a global, cross-server board (including the 악명 board). Server-scope hidden rows can also be matched back to a player, because their Value equals the replicated CombatPower attribute. This is acceptable because the player is in the same server anyway.
problems.fix: Keep DisplayName: it is policy-safe and avoids stale-filter problems. Say it in the setting text: '전체 랭킹에는 로블록스 이름과 얼굴이 나와요. 숨기면 "<진영> 한 명"으로 보여요'. No change for the Server scope.

problems.problem: '이번 판 영웅' rewards whoever has the most war points. PvPKOPoints = 20 against 1 per monster (WarService config near Config.luau:715-717), so the hero is in practice the top PK of the round, announced to the whole server by name.
problems.fix: Use AnnounceService.PublicName. Pick the hero from war points excluding PvP KO points, or cap the PvP share at 50% of the hero score. This is a launch item; note it in the spec only.

missing_features: AnnounceService.PublicName(player): one name source for every server-wide mention (all NotifyAll sites, kaijuName, the town board, rankings, BB36) that honors HideAnnounceName, plus a grep acceptance check (0 raw Util.PlayerDisplayName inside NotifyAll).

RankingService.PvPCreditOK(killer, victim): fair fight only (BoldMult >= 1); victim manually active within 60 s; not Roblox friends; victim AccountAge >= 7 and PlaytimeSeconds >= 3h; killer-side 3 per victim per week; victim-side MaxYieldPerVictimPerDay = 5. Applied at KO time, including the grudge sack (AddToSack rankPts) and payLeaveBounty.

Season-scoped ranking fields (data.Rank = {Season, BestPower, BestGrowth}), a persisted DebugTainted flag set by every DebugCommand branch, and Config.Ranking.ExcludeUserIds, so Studio-boosted dev and test saves never reach the beta or launch boards.
Server-side pre-KO bully warning to the attacker (PvPService.WouldBeBully: weak, fresh spawn or repeat KO) in place of the red '약한 상대' billboard.
Must-write path for the hide toggle (retry until success, RankHideSynced flag, instant local re-mask of cached rows).

Data erasure procedure (docs/ops/data_erasure.md + tools/erase_user.py) covering the main save, nickname stores, every HH_Rank_<Season>_<Store>[_W<n>] store and the mail store; Config.Ranking.SeasonHistory.
Beta abuse log: refused ranking credits with their reason, plunder totals per killer/victim pair, and BestGrowth jumps per hour, feeding the A23-18 pre-launch check.
Shared Config.Bully.Text with all three bully conditions, used by BB4 PowerNote, BB8, BB15 Help and the pre-KO warning.

user_questions to add (short Korean): (1) '주간 명예·악명 랭킹에 PvP 처치를 셀 때, 비슷하거나 센 상대(내 전투력 80% 이상)·친구가 아닌 상대·방금까지 직접 움직이던 상대만 점수로 칠까요? (추천: 예. 명예·악명 자체와 골드는 그대로)' (2) '자리 비움으로 자동 사냥 중인 플레이어(A23-20)를 고블린 숲·해골 유적에서 털 수 있게 그대로 둘까요? (추천: 공격·털기는 그대로, 랭킹 점수만 없음)' (3) 'PvP 지역의 빨간 "약한 상대" 머리 표시 대신, 쓰러뜨리기 직전 공격자에게만 "지금 쓰러뜨리면 깡패" 경고를 띄울까요? (추천: 예)'
crits.overall:
The spec is policy-safe on the basics, but its anti-abuse layer is too thin for a PvP game played by children aged 8-14.

What is already safe:
- No new chat surface.
- Global boards use Roblox DisplayName.
- Game nicknames are already broadcast-filtered and re-filtered on join.
- Blocking uses PromptBlockPlayer.
- Rankings carry no rewards by default.
- Studio writes go to a STUDIO season.

Blocking problems:
1. BB17 contradicts the user's newer A23-20 decision ('계속 사냥'; the feature already exists in 5c977d6 and is OFF on purpose). It must be dropped.
2. The weekly 명예/악명 boards are in practice PK leaderboards, because story points are one-time and repeatable points come only from PvP KOs. Their filters miss friend kill-trading, AFK auto-hunters, weak-but-not-bully victims, pre-aged alts and repeat targeting of one child by many killers. The plunder path bypasses per-victim checks entirely, because sack.Infamy is aggregated (GrudgeService.luau:324/207).
3. The renamed '알림·랭킹에 내 이름 숨기기' setting would be false: 7+ NotifyAll sites (Most Wanted, bounty, avenge, rebirth, goose, kaiju) and the town board's '깡패' line ignore it.
4. Debug-boosted dev and test saves live in the real DataStore and carry to launch (A23-18). Because BestPower/BestGrowth are all-time save fields, a season rename does not reset the Power and Growth boards.

Medium items:
- BB28's red 'weak' billboard is a target finder and misses the fresh-spawn and repeat bully rules. Replace it with a server-side pre-KO warning.
- BullyNote is over-simplified.
- A hide toggle can be skipped by budget.
- payLeaveBounty credit lacks a VictimUserId.
- No right-to-erasure procedure exists for the new UserId-keyed stores.

Add the three short Korean questions in missing_features to user_questions. They cover PvP-credit rules, plunder of AFK hunters and the weak-marker replacement. Everything else above is a technical fix the worker can apply without asking.

Line numbers in PvPService, GrudgeService and Config are shifting under active worker edits (uncommitted diffs). Cite by function name and route all fame grants through one helper.

CombatService.Release(:842-1008)를 castSkill(player, def, isAuto)로 일반화한다. 쿨다운은 슬롯마다 따로 둔다(guard.skillAt[player][slot]). 스킬 사이에 공동 0.5초 SkillGap을 두고, 그 안에 누르면 1회 줄 세운다. 'Release'는 Q 별칭으로 남긴다(:1177). 새 원격 UseSkill(slot)·LearnSkill(skillId), RateLimits 0.25/1. UseSkill도 lastManualAt을 갱신한다. 속성은 SkillZ(배운 id 또는 "")와 SkillReadyAt_Z. Released 페이로드에 SkillId·Slot을 더한다(소비처: QuestService.luau:921-926, StoryQuestService.luau:165, KaijuService.luau:638). 저장은 Skills.Learned = {[skillId]=true}만 한다. Q는 저장하지 않으므로 이관이 필요 없다. gaps.feature: 입력 지도 공용 모듈 Keybinds (하드코딩 키 제거)
gaps.proposal: Config.Keybinds를 만든다. Actions(순서대로): Attack F/R2, SkillQ Q/L2, SkillZ Z/L1(ZEnabled일 때만 보임), Auto R/R1, PotionHP One/DPadUp, PotionMP Two/DPadDown, Interact E/ButtonX(Roblox ProximityPrompt 기본), Bag G, Character C, Skills K, Ranking L, Menu B/ButtonY, Map M/DPadLeft, Upgrade U. 행마다 Group·Label(한국어)·LabelEn을 둔다. Reserved: Escape, Slash, Tab, Return, KeypadEnter, W, A, S, D, Space, Up, Down, Left, Right, I, O(Roblox 카메라 줌), LeftShift, RightShift(시프트 락), F9-F12, LeftSuper, RightSuper. Allowed: 예약을 뺀 글자 A–Z와 숫자 0–9만(단순하게). 새 클라이언트 모듈 Keybinds.luau를 ClientMain ORDER에서 UIKit 바로 뒤(Fx·VitalsUI·HUD보다 앞)에 둔다. API: Get(action)->KeyCode, ActionFor(keyCode)->action, Label(action), Changed 시그널, SetLocal(map), Reset(). 바꿀 곳: HUD.onInputBegan/onInputEnded(:2964-3012)는 ActionFor로 분기(상태는 L 테이블에 담아 200 local 한도 보호). 배지(:1378/1418/1421/1424/1429)와 VitalsUI 배지(:129-131)는 Changed 때 다시 그린다. VitalsUI 물약(:212-216)도 ActionFor를 쓴다. WorldMap M(:1768)은 Changed 때 UnbindAction 후 새 키로 다시 Bind한다. 상호작용 키는 클라이언트가 ProximityPromptService.PromptShown에서 prompt.KeyboardKeyCode를 내 키로 바꾼다. 서버 판정은 PromptTriggered라 영향이 없다. 서버가 프롬프트를 다시 만들면 속성 변경 신호에서 다시 적용한다(Studio 확인 필요). 왼클릭 공격·드래그 카메라(CameraFollow)와 오프닝 Enter는 바꾸지 않는다.

gaps.feature: 키 설정 화면 + 키 입력 받기 + 충돌 처리
gaps.proposal: Panels에 BUILDERS.Settings를 두고 Keybinds.BuildPage로 넘긴다. 메뉴에 '설정' 항목을 넣고, '오프닝 다시 보기'와 '이름 숨기기'도 이 화면으로 옮겨 메뉴를 줄인다. 행은 그룹(전투/물약/창/기타) · 이름 · [현재 키] 버튼이다. 누르면 '바꿀 키를 누르세요 (5초)' + [취소]가 뜬다. 입력 받기는 ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority('HHC_KeyCapture', fn, false, 4000, Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard)로 모든 키를 Sink한다. 이 우선순위는 지도 3010·오프닝 3000보다 높아서 M·B를 눌러도 창이 닫히지 않는다. 끝나면 Unbind한다. Esc는 Roblox 메뉴 몫이라 받을 수 없으므로 취소는 버튼과 시간 초과로 한다. 규칙: 예약 키는 거절하고 '그 키는 로블록스가 써요'를 띄운다. Allowed 밖의 키도 거절한다. 다른 동작이 이미 쓰는 키면 맞바꾼다(그 동작이 내 옛 키를 받음) + 토스트 'Z ↔ Q 맞바꿨어요'. 그래서 키 없는 동작이 생기지 않는다(초보·아이 배려). 조합키는 없다. [기본값으로 되돌리기]는 확인을 한 번 받는다. 바뀐 키는 바로 적용하고, 저장은 창을 닫을 때나 마지막 변경 1초 뒤에 SetSettings 1회로 보낸다. 서버가 돌려준 값이 다르면 그 값으로 되돌린다. 터치 전용 기기는 키 탭 대신 '키보드가 없어요' 안내를 보여 주고 기타 설정만 둔다. 게임패드는 베타에서 고정 배치표를 보여 주기만 한다.

gaps.why_basic: 사용자가 '원하는 대로'라고 했다. 키를 바꾸는 화면과 충돌 규칙이 없으면 키 설정이 아니다.

gaps.proposal: Config.Data.Defaults에 Settings = { Keys = {}, Sfx = 1, Shake = true }를 추가한다. Keys는 기본값과 다른 것만 담는 희소 맵(action → KeyCode.Name)이다. 그래서 나중에 기본값을 바꾸면 키를 안 바꾼 사람은 자동으로 따라간다. 덧붙이는 필드라 Version 3을 유지한다(AutoCombatUnlocked·HideAnnounceName 전례. fillDefaults :127-136은 모르는 키를 지우지 않음). 정리기는 순수 함수 Config.SanitizeSettings(t)로 서버·클라이언트가 같이 쓴다. Keys는 Actions에 있는 문자열 키 + Allowed 값만 남기고 예약 키는 버린다. 기본값과 합친 실제 지도에 중복이 생기면 Keys를 통째로 비운다. 항목 수는 #Actions 이하, Sfx는 0~1 0.1 단위, Shake는 불리언. DataService.fillDefaults에서도 이 정리기를 호출한다. 새 서버 모듈 SettingsService.luau를 Main.server.luau INIT_ORDER/START_ORDER(:9-22)에 넣는다. 원격 SetSettings(blob): select('#')==1, 테이블, 문자열 길이 ≤ 24, RateLimits.SetSettings = 1, IsReady를 확인한 뒤 정리된 것만 data.Settings에 저장한다. 결과는 본인 전용 원격 'Settings'로 돌려준다(PlayerReady 때도 1회. Inventory·Quests 본인 전용 패턴, Net.luau:22-26). 속성 미러는 하지 않는다.

risks: 이 감사 중에도 작업 세션이 Config.luau를 고치고 있었다(git diff: 12줄 추가·6줄 삭제). 그 사이 줄 번호가 2~6줄 밀렸으므로(BasicSkill 395→397, RateLimits 1476→1482) 구현할 때는 심볼 이름으로 다시 찾는다.
Luau 200 local 한도: 최상위 local 근사치는 HUD ~150, Fx ~171, WorldMap ~176, Panels ~140이다. 새 코드는 새 모듈(Keybinds, SkillBook, SettingsService)과 기존 테이블(L, COL, TXT)에 넣는다.

ClientMain ORDER(ClientMain.client.luau:2)와 Main INIT/START(Main.server.luau:9-22)는 WaitForChild 고정 목록이다. 새 모듈 파일이 Studio에 먼저 들어간 뒤에만 목록에 넣어야 하고, 아니면 클라이언트나 서버가 멈춘다. tools/sync_to_studio.py는 Play를 멈추므로 실행 전에 한국어로 알린다.
키 입력 받기를 높은 우선순위로 Sink하지 않으면, M(WorldMap.luau:1266-1271, :1785)과 B(HUD.luau:2966-2970)를 누르는 순간 설정 창이 닫힌다. Esc는 Roblox 메뉴가 가져가서 받을 수 없다.
Roblox 기본 카메라가 I/O(줌)와 Left/Right(회전)를 Pass로 묶어 둔다. 그래서 게임 동작을 I에 묶으면 카메라 줌도 같이 일어난다. 그래서 가방 기본키를 I가 아니라 G로 제안했다. 예약 목록은 Studio에서 한 번 실측해야 한다.
ProximityPrompt.KeyboardKeyCode를 클라이언트에서 바꾸는 방법은 이 코드베이스에서 검증된 적이 없다. 서버가 프롬프트를 다시 만들면(MapBuilder ensure 함수들) 값이 되돌아갈 수 있으니 속성 변경 때 다시 적용하고 Studio에서 확인한다.
데이터 버전: Settings·Skills는 덧붙이는 필드라 Version 3을 유지해야 한다. 버전을 올리면 아직 도는 옛 서버가 그 기록을 거부한다(DataService.luau:330, CR-L3).
A22/A23-1의 '다음 해금 예고 금지' 규칙 때문에 X 줄과 플래그가 꺼진 Z 줄은 스킬창에 보이면 안 된다. 사용자가 잠긴 스킬 트리 전체를 보고 싶어 하면 이 규칙과 부딪히므로 그때 묻는다(규칙 질문).
A23-15의 10/20 점검에서 Z 플래그를 끌 수 있다. 스킬창 Z 줄, 키 설정 SkillZ 행, HUD Z 버튼, autoTick이 모두 같은 Config.Skills.ZEnabled 하나를 보게 한다.
스킬별 자동 끄기는 A23-1 문구('자동은 스킬도 씀')의 플레이어 선택 예외다. 기본값을 켬으로 두면 계약은 유지된다.
공격 키를 F에서 다른 키로 바꿔도 짧은 왼클릭 공격(CameraFollow PrimaryClick → HUD.luau:3392)은 그대로 남는다. 테스트하는 사람이 헷갈리지 않게 설정 화면에 한 줄로 적어 둔다.
폰(터치 전용)에는 키가 없다. 설정 화면이 폰에서 빈 화면이 되지 않게 효과음·흔들림 같은 기타 설정을 함께 넣거나, 키 탭을 숨긴다.

Art: item icons are old GPT art scheduled for deletion, T8 and all materials have no icon, grade slot frames are not drawn; must stay on code fallbacks (no invented visual styling) until Firefly parts are approved.

risks: Luau 200-locals limit: HUD.luau has about 148 top-level local statements and Fx.luau about 168. Put the power label and popup state in ui/L/TXT/Feel tables or a new ClientMain module (remember the WaitForChild ORDER list).

Attribute write order: WeaponTier changes before WeaponEnhance (LootService.luau:467-470), so an uncoalesced listener shows a wrong value for a moment and fires two popups. The bully test can also read the mixed state for a moment.
If the bully/boldness rules keep comparing floats while the UI shows rounded integers, a player who reads '절반 미만' off the screen can be ruled differently at the boundary. Use the same integer.

Showing exact enemy power could help picking victims just above the 50% bully line (noted in docs/design/mmorpg_painpoints_ideas_2026-10-05.json:1049). Mitigations: boldness x0.5, the A23-18 60 s graduation grace, and only relative markers on nametags.

A class-free number means a Warrior (HP x1.3) and a Mage (HP x0.8) with the same level and weapon show the same power. Adding class would change the bully and boldness PvP rules, which needs the user's decision. Explain it in the character window instead.

Weapons dominate the number: a reborn Lv1 with T7+10 shows 4,472 against a fresh Lv15 with an iron weapon at 1,080 (A23-14 keeps weapons through rebirth). The global board will favour veterans; consider level-band boards after beta.
Ranking by current power would punish rebirth (Lv50 T7+10 15,285 -> Lv1 4,472). Use BestPower for the global board.
After the 12/19 auction opens, gold can buy weapons, so power becomes indirectly purchasable if Robux->gold is ever sold. Keep the GDD §10 no-stat-sales rule and add 'no Robux->gold'.
PvP damage uses a weapon-damage ratio clamped to 0.8-1.5 (CombatService.luau:414-418), not 전투력. Without a help line, kids will think the number is lying when a '3x stronger' player loses.
Faction sums (GetPower) include the rebirth multiplier and now also kept weapons, so rebirthers inflate Size Justice. This is a separate balance check; do not show HaloPower/HornsPower as '전투력'.
Popup spam in the first 10 minutes (Config.Levels EarlyUntil = 10, many quick level-ups): merge it into the level-up announce.
All new player-facing strings must go into central text tables for the planned English version (RELEASE_PLAN.md:41). Avoid glyphs Gotham renders as tofu (CR-L44).

① 전투력: floor(전투력). HUD·장비창과 같은 함수를 쓴다.

④ 악명: 뿔 군단만.
③④는 [이번 주(기본) | 전체] 두 기간이 있다.
범위 탭은 [이 서버]와 [전체] 두 가지다. [이 서버]는 접속자로 실시간 계산하고 DataStore를 쓰지 않는다. [전체]는 OrderedDataStore를 쓴다.
저장소 이름: 'HH_Rank_<Season>_<Board>', 주간은 뒤에 '_W<week>'를 붙인다. Config.Ranking.Season='B1'로 두면 초기화가 필요할 때 숫자만 올리면 된다. A23-18에서 베타 저장이 정식까지 이어지기 때문에 필요하다.
키는 'U_<userId>'다. 값은 점수×100 + 숨김(0/1)×10 + 진영(0~3)으로 넣는다. 이렇게 하면 추가 읽기 없이도 접속하지 않은 사람의 진영과 숨김 여부를 안다.
원격: Net.Names에 'RequestRankings'(c→s, boardId·scope·period; 서버가 Config.Ranking.Boards로 검사, RateLimits 1.0초)와 'Rankings'(s→c)를 더한다. 'Rankings'는 { Board, Scope, Period, Rows≤50 {Rank, UserId, Name, Faction, Value, Sub}, Me {Rank|nil, Value}, UpdatedAt } 형태의 캐시 사본이다.

gaps.why_basic: 전체 랭킹은 서버 예산(GetSortedAsync는 분당 5+2×인원, 정렬 저장소 쓰기는 분당 60+10×인원, 같은 키는 6초에 한 번) 안에서 돌아야 한다. 저장(DataService)보다 먼저 예산을 써 버리면 안 된다.
gaps.proposal:
쓰기:
- 바뀐 값만 dirty로 표시한다.
- 한 사람당 120초마다 시간을 엇갈려 쓴다.
- 환생, 진영 변경, PlayerLeaving(최종 저장 전) 때는 즉시 쓴다.
- 같은 키는 6초 이상 간격을 둔다. 값이 같으면 쓰지 않는다.
- 쓰기 전에 DataStoreService:GetRequestBudgetForRequestType(SetIncrementSortedAsync)를 확인하고, 5 미만이면 미룬다.
- BindToClose(PlayerService CLOSE_TIMEOUT 25초)에서는 저장을 먼저 하고, 남은 예산이 있을 때만 랭킹을 쓴다.

읽기:
- 서버마다 게시판·기간별로 GetSortedAsync(false, 50)를 180초 간격으로 엇갈려 부른다. 분당 2~3회로, 1명 서버의 예산 7회 안에 든다.
- 결과를 서버에 캐시하고, 클라이언트는 그 캐시만 받는다. 클릭할 때마다 DataStore를 부르지 않는다.

이름:
- 모르는 userId는 UserService:GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync로 한꺼번에 묻고 1시간 캐시한다. pcall로 감싸고, 실패하면 '플레이어'로 보여 준다.

내 순위:
- OrderedDataStore는 특정 키의 순위를 알려 주지 않는다. 그래서 50위 안이면 순위를 보여 주고, 아니면 '50위 밖 · 내 점수 N'으로 보여 준다.
