risks: OrderedDataStore는 특정 키의 순위를 주지 않는다. '내 순위'는 50위 밖이면 '50위 밖 · 점수 N'으로만 보여 줄 수 있다. 정확한 순위를 원하면 정식 이후 별도 설계가 필요하다.
GetSortedAsync 예산(분당 5+2×인원)은 1명 서버에서 7회뿐이다. 게시판×기간 조합이 8개를 넘거나 클릭할 때마다 조회하면 예산을 넘는다. 서버 캐시와 180초 엇갈림 갱신이 필수다.
Studio 테스트가 실제 랭킹을 오염시킬 수 있다. 작업용 비공개 장소(81671223175574)는 DataStore가 켜져 있고 DebugCommand로 레벨·골드를 바꿀 수 있다(Main.server.luau:53+). IsStudio/IsMemoryMode 가드가 없으면 디버그 값이 전체 1위에 오른다.
베타 저장이 정식까지 이어진다(A23-18). 베타 중 악용이 확인되면 랭킹만 초기화할 방법이 필요하므로 Config.Ranking.Season으로 저장소 이름을 바꿔 초기화할 수 있게 해야 한다.
OrderedDataStore는 만료(TTL)가 없어 주간 저장소가 계속 쌓인다(비용은 없지만 정리가 안 된다). MemoryStore SortedMap은 TTL이 있지만 메모리 할당량이 동시 접속자 수에 묶여 있어, 주간 참가자가 많으면 위험하다. 베타에는 OrderedDataStore를 추천한다.
명예·악명 랭킹은 PK 동기를 키운다. 주당 같은 상대 3회 상한, 계정 나이 검사, 그리고 A23-18 대담함 배율(아직 미구현)이 함께 들어가지 않으면 갓 졸업한 Lv15 새싹이 표적이 된다(mmorpg_painpoints_ideas json:1049,1511).
무료 전향으로 명예/악명이 0이 되는 규칙(FactionService:353-359)과 변경권 전향(둘 다 유지)을 랭킹에 반영하지 않으면, 떠난 진영 게시판에 옛 점수가 남는다.
기사단도 스토리 선택으로 악명을 얻는다(StoryQuestService:474). 그래서 악명 게시판은 지금 뿔 군단인 사람만 올리는 규칙을 명시해야 헷갈리지 않는다.
전투력 숫자는 '전투력 표시' 영역(HUD·장비창)과 반드시 같은 정수 함수를 써야 한다. 그렇지 않으면 화면 숫자와 랭킹 숫자가 달라 보인다. GetPower(환생 보너스 포함)와 GetCombatPower(제외) 중 하나를 골라야 한다.
UserService:GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync는 제한에 걸리거나 실패할 수 있다. pcall, 1시간 캐시, '플레이어' 대체가 필요하다. 접속하지 않은 사람의 게임 닉네임은 다시 필터해야 하므로 띄우지 않는다.
Panels.luau는 최상위 local이 134개, HUD/Fx는 200개 제한에 가깝다. 랭킹 UI는 새 모듈로 분리해야 한다. 모듈을 지울 때는 ClientMain/Main 목록에서 먼저 빼야 멈추지 않는다(AGENTS 규칙).
랭킹 보상(칭호·골드)을 줄지는 공정성 결정이라 사용자 확인이 필요하다. 추천은 베타에는 보상 없이 표시만 하는 것이다. 보상을 붙이면 PK·부계정 농사 동기가 크게 오른다.
일정: 기능 마감 10/24 전에 인벤토리·장비창·전투력·키 설정과 함께 들어가야 한다. RankingService(M)·UI(M)·악용 방지(M)를 합치면 약 4~5일 작업이다. 전투력 정의가 먼저 정해져야 착수할 수 있다.

gaps.proposal: New server SettingsService (Init/Start, add to Main.server.luau INIT_ORDER/START_ORDER) owns data.Settings. Add Config.Data.Defaults.Settings = {}: it is additive, so no version bump is needed (pattern noted at DataService.luau:159), and fillDefaults sanitizes each key. Config.Settings.Defs = {Key={Type,Min,Max,Options,Default}} plus a Text table (KO now, keys for EN). Remote 'SetSetting'(key,value) validated against Defs, with RateLimits.SetSetting 0.2 and a client debounce of 0.5 s for sliders. An owner-only 's->c Settings' payload on PlayerReady follows the Inventory pattern (Net.luau:23-26). New client module Settings.luau, added to ClientMain ORDER after Panels and exposing IsOpen. Rows: background-music volume, SFX volume, camera sensitivity (multiplies CameraFollow RADIANS_PER_PIXEL), screen shake on/off (Fx.Shake), damage numbers (mine/all/off), other players' nametags (all/near/off; sets the local BillboardGui 'Nametag' Enabled/MaxDistance on other characters), UI size 90/100/115% (multiplier in UIKit applyScale), language (auto/한국어/English, once L(key) exists), the P5 '알림에 내 이름' entry moved here from Panels.luau:1245, a key-settings sub-page, and a version footer. Build it with existing PanelParchment/UIKit parts and code fallbacks only.

roblox_api_notes.note: Values must be integers. GetSortedAsync page size is at most 100. Per-server budgets: ordered-store writes (SetAsync/IncrementAsync/UpdateAsync) 30 + 5×players per minute; GetSortedAsync 5 + 2×players per minute; standard data store reads and writes 60 + 40×players each. Keys and store names are at most 50 characters. So run one server loop that refreshes each board every 60-120 s and caches the result for clients. Write a player's board scores on autosave and on leave, not on every kill. Store combat power as a scaled integer (e.g. ×10, floored).

roblox_api_notes.topic: Official leaderboard tutorial pattern and lag
roblox_api_notes.note: The tutorial keys scores by userId, saves with SetAsync every 30 s and when the player leaves, and resolves names with Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync inside pcall (fallback 'Unknown'). It warns that backend caching can delay updates by a few seconds and points to memory stores for real-time boards. Its 3-second client refresh would exceed the GetSortedAsync budget at scale; refresh on the server instead.

roblox_api_notes.topic: Player's own rank outside the top 100
roblox_api_notes.note: Neither OrderedDataStore nor MemoryStore can return the rank of an arbitrary key. The only way is to page through the sorted results, which is practical only for small lists (devforum estimate about 700 or fewer). Show the player's own score plus '100위 밖' (or their position if they appear in the cached top-N pages).

Roblox docs: all-time rankings belong in ordered data stores; daily and monthly leaderboards are a memory-store use case, and memory-store data lives at most 45 days (3,888,000 s). GetRangeAsync returns at most 200 items per call. The sort key may be a number or a string; numeric sort keys order first. Quotas: memory 64 KB + 1.2 KB × users; requests 1000 + 120 × concurrent users per minute; one sorted map sits on one partition, which throttles around 30,000 request units per minute; at most 1,000,000 items and 100 MB. Request costs: GetRangeAsync costs as many units as items returned, and UpdateAsync costs at least 2. Pattern: one map per week (e.g. 'Hunt_W<weekIndex>'), expiry about 14 days, the server writes via UpdateAsync only when a value rises, throttled per player. At beta size (a few users) the memory quota is small (~64 KB + 1.2 KB × users), so keep entries tiny (userId → integer, sortKey = score).

roblox_api_notes.topic: Data store best practices for scores and settings
roblox_api_notes.note: Keep one record per player under one key (e.g. User_<id>) while it fits in 4 MB. Wrap calls in pcall with exponential backoff plus jitter. Prefer UpdateAsync when several servers may write. Save periodically, on leave, on shutdown, and at purchase checkpoints. The repo already has a session-locked UpdateAsync profile (src/ServerScriptService/DataService.luau:1, 199-220), so settings and keybinds go into that profile, not into a new data store.

UserService:GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync(ids) returns Id/Username/DisplayName/HasVerifiedBadge in bulk. Output order may not match input, and invalid ids are dropped. It is limited to 250 results per minute (HTTP 429 beyond that), so cache names in server memory between refreshes. Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync also works; Roblox's examples cache results.

Text a player typed, such as a nickname, must be filtered before other players see it; Roblox can remove games that do not filter. TextService:FilterStringAsync throws if fromUserId is not online on the current server, so a global board cannot re-filter an offline player's nickname. Show the nickname snapshot that was broadcast-filtered while its owner was online. The repo already filters with GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync and stores the result (src/ServerScriptService/NicknameService.luau:220-231, 238-241). Otherwise fall back to the Roblox DisplayName.

roblox_api_notes.topic: Policy for leaderboards that show usernames
roblox_api_notes.note: Observation, not a quoted rule: I found no Roblox rule against showing Roblox usernames or display names on leaderboards; Roblox moderates those names itself. The filtering requirement applies to player-typed text. Recommended anyway for a kid audience: a 'hide my name on rankings' toggle (repo precedent HideAnnounceName, Config.luau:124), and no ranking based on Robux spending. For the future gacha (documented only, GDD §10-1), PolicyService:GetPolicyInfoForPlayerAsync().ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted must be checked.

roblox_api_notes.topic: Input Action System (IAS) status and rebinding
roblox_api_notes.note: IAS reached full release on 2026-06-11 (devforum). InputContext has Enabled, Priority and Sink (a menu context can swallow gameplay input). InputAction has types Bool/Direction1D/2D/3D/ViewportPosition, events Pressed/Released/StateChanged, and a read-only PreferredBinding. InputBinding has KeyCode, UIButton (touch), UIModifier, DisplayName and DisplayImage. InputActionLabel (beta) shows the right key glyph per device. There is no official player-remap feature yet: Roblox says it is 'actively investigating native frameworks to support player-side key remapping'. Community modules (e.g. EZInput) rebind by changing InputBinding.KeyCode at runtime and export/apply saved bindings. Roblox also migrated the default PlayerScripts to IAS and asks games with custom input logic to audit them; this repo uses UserInputService/ContextActionService directly (HUD.luau:2964-2993, WorldMap.luau:1765-1768, Intro.luau:307-310), so test movement and the keys after that migration.

roblox_api_notes.topic: Rebinding with UserInputService / ContextActionService (lower-risk path for beta)
roblox_api_notes.note: Keep a central keymap table (action → KeyCode name) and resolve keys through it in InputBegan. Ignore input when gameProcessedEvent is true (typing in chat or a TextBox). With ContextActionService, rebinding means UnbindAction(name) and then BindActionAtPriority(name, fn, false, priority, newKey). Return Sink to stop lower handlers, Pass to let them run. Its createTouchButton can generate mobile buttons (SetTitle/SetImage/SetPosition), but our own UIKit buttons are better. UserInputService.PreferredInput (Touch / Gamepad / KeyboardAndMouse) chooses which hints to show. UserInputService:GetStringForKeyCode gives the key label for the player's keyboard layout. Note: HUD.luau and Fx.luau are near the 200-local limit (AGENTS.md), so put the keymap and settings windows in a new client module (registered in the ClientMain module list) and keep their state in tables.

roblox_api_notes.topic: Reserved / default Roblox keys to refuse or warn about
roblox_api_notes.note: Roblox core UI uses: Esc (Roblox menu), / (chat), Tab (player list), ` (backpack), . (emotes), F9 (developer console), Ctrl+Shift+G (hide GUI), Print Screen. The default controls use WASD/Space, Shift (shift lock), I/O (zoom) and 1-0 (backpack tools). The repo disables the Backpack and Health core GUI (VitalsUI.luau:210-211), so ` and 1-0 are partly free, but 1/2 are already potions (VitalsUI.luau:214-215). The rebind UI should reject Esc / '/' / Tab / F9 / WASD / Space and warn about the others.

Experiences have no persistent client storage, and clients cannot write data stores. Pattern: the server loads Settings from the profile and sends them on join (or mirrors them as attributes). The client edits and sends one table over a RemoteEvent. The server validates against a whitelist: known action ids, Enum.KeyCode names (not numbers), no reserved keys, no duplicates, volumes clamped to 0-1, booleans only, plus a rate limit. It then saves and echoes the clean copy back. Store KeyCode as the enum name string, and add a Settings version number for migration.

GuiService.TopbarInset is a Rect of the unoccupied top-bar area beside Roblox's own buttons; listen with GetPropertyChangedSignal('TopbarInset'). ScreenInsets: CoreUISafeInsets (default; keeps UI clear of top-bar buttons and cutouts; recommended for interactive UI), DeviceSafeInsets (only notches), TopbarSafeInsets (lay items inside the top-bar strip, adjusting dynamically), None. Place [가방][지도][메뉴] either in a TopbarSafeInsets ScreenGui sized from TopbarInset or just below it in CoreUISafeInsets, and never under the Roblox buttons. GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize (Enum.DisplaySize.Small) can switch to the compact phone layout.

GuiService.PreferredTextSize (Medium…Largest; AutomaticSize text grows with it), GuiService.PreferredTransparency (1 = default, 0 = fully opaque; multiply BackgroundTransparency by it), GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled (set tween time to 0 and drop camera shake). Read them on start and with GetPropertyChangedSignal. Docs also ask for separate volume groups (music, SFX, speech).

Simplest for the local player: set character.Archivable = true, Clone, remove scripts, and parent the clone to a WorldModel inside the ViewportFrame (a WorldModel is needed for animations). Set ViewportFrame.CurrentCamera to a new Camera and light it with Ambient/LightColor/LightDirection. Known issue: the cloned Animate script may not run inside a WorldModel, so play an idle through the clone's Animator from your own client code. For other players (inspect, top-3 board) use Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync + CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync, or CreateHumanoidModelFromUserIdAsync; the sync versions are deprecated. For ranking rows, cheap headshots via Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, size) avoid many viewports on phones.

The folder must be named 'leaderstats' (lowercase) and may hold IntValue/NumberValue/StringValue. Columns follow the order values are added (IsPrimary/Priority can change it). roblox_api_notes.topic: Localization hook for the language setting
roblox_api_notes.note: LocalizationService:GetTranslatorForPlayerAsync(player) returns a Translator with LocaleId; listen to its LocaleId changes. Players can change language in the Roblox in-game Settings menu. Our own KO/EN override goes into the saved settings and drives the central text tables (docs/RELEASE_PLAN.md:39-42).

Feature freeze is 2026-10-24 and beta 2026-10-31 (AGENTS.md). New functional windows may use existing approved UI parts and UIKit code fallbacks without new art (AGENTS.md gameplay-first exception); brand-new visual looks need a Firefly image first. Server-authoritative: combat power, ranks and saved settings are computed or validated on the server, and every new remote is validated and rate-limited. Add any new client module to the fixed WaitForChild list in ClientMain.client.luau, and any server service to the list in Main.server.luau.
